mobile.accord_section_pending: Haɗin sa hannun da ke jira
mobile.accord_sign_as_holder_desc: Amincewa, atisaye, da sanarwa — kumburin ne ke sa hannunsu a kan YubiKey na mai riƙe da yarjejeniyarku — manhajar ba ta riƙe da wani maɓalli ba. Zaɓi maɓallin mai riƙenku, foldar USB, da PIN sau ɗaya; dukkan ayyukan uku za su sake amfani da su.
mobile.accord_sign_as_holder_needed: Zaɓi maɓallin mai riƙenku, foldar USB, da PIN don sa hannu a wani aiki.
mobile.accord_sign_as_holder_no_holders: Babu masu riƙe da yarjejeniya a wannan kumburi tukuna.
mobile.accord_sign_as_holder_select: Zaɓi maɓallin mai riƙe da yarjejeniyarku…
mobile.accord_sign_as_holder_title: Sa hannu a matsayin mai riƙe
mobile.accord_subtitle: Masu riƙe da maɓallan kafuwa waɗanda ke ɗaure ragar canonical kuma suke riƙe da maɓallin kashewa tare. Kowa na iya gani; masu riƙe da yarjejeniya ne kaɗai za su iya aiki. Manhajar ba ta riƙe da wani maɓalli ba; kumburin ne ke sa hannu.
mobile.add_fedid_intro: Kun riga kun shiga — wannan yana ƙara ID na tarayya ga asusunku na yanzu ba tare da sake ƙirƙirar shi ba. Za a kiyaye hanyar shigarku.
mobile.add_fedid_label_heading: Sa wa ID ɗin tarayyarku suna
mobile.age_range_card_body: Kewayon shekarunku na bayyana kanku ne, kuma kumburin gida na wannan na'ura ne ke rubuta shi — manhajar ba ta taɓa riƙe maɓallai. Ku ke sarrafa saitin ku da kanku; ba a taɓa hukunta amsar da ba daidai ba, sai dai a sake duba ta. Wani fili mai taushin hali na iya buƙatar tabbataccen mataki daga baya, wanda bayyana kai kaɗai ba ya biya.
mobile.age_range_card_title: Dalilin da ya sa muke tambaya
mobile.age_range_explainer: An fara gina aminci tun farko. Yanzu da kuke da ID, ku faɗa mana kewayon shekarunku. Wannan yana saita kariya ta asali — ƙananan yara ba sa ganin abun ciki na manya. Kuna iya canja wannan a kowane lokaci daga shafin Aminci.
mobile.age_range_footnote: Na zaɓi ne — ƙin amsawa yana saita kariyar asali (za a ɗauke ku a matsayin ƙarami). Kuna iya bayyana kewayon shekarunku daga baya a shafin Aminci.
mobile.age_range_saved: An saita kewayon shekarunku. Kariya ta asali tana aiki.
mobile.announce_decision_body_off: A KASHE (an ba da shawara): sirri gaba ɗaya. Kumburinku ya tsaya ga kanku kaɗai — komai na aiki a gida kuma yana daidaita a duk na'urorinku, amma al'umma ba za ta iya gani ko isa gare shi ba. Kunna wannan don aika bayanan tunani da shiga al'ummomi.
mobile.announce_decision_body_on: A KUNNE: kumburinku zai zama abin gani a tarayya. Wannan shi ne ke ba ku damar aika bayanan tunani zuwa amintaccen rukunin sabobin canonical da shiga al'ummomi yayin da suke zuwa. Kuna iya kashe wannan daga baya.
mobile.announce_decision_toggle_label: Sa kumburina ya zama abin gani a tarayya
mobile.announce_decision_trace_desc: Raba makin ingancin tunani da tsarin yanke shawara (babu abun cikin saƙo) tare da amintaccen rukunin sabobin canonical.
mobile.announce_decision_trace_locked: Kunna sanarwa a sama don ba da damar aika bayanan tunani da shiga al'ummomi.
mobile.child_safety_class_csam: CSAM (samun daidaito na shigar da cirewa kai tsaye — yana kuma buƙatar wajibin cirewa)
mobile.child_safety_class_other: Sauran abun ciki (daidaito na tura tuta zuwa mai sa ido)
mobile.child_safety_current_enables: Jerin bibiya na yanzu na wannan rukuni
mobile.child_safety_group_label: key_id na rukuni (dole ku kasance mai sa ido a kansa)
mobile.child_safety_honesty_hashes: Bayanan hash na CSAM mai gudanarwa ne ke tanadar da su (ba a taɓa aika su tare da manhajar ba), kuma rahoton da doka ke buƙata wajibin mai gudanarwa ne, ba na fabric ba.
mobile.child_safety_honesty_noprivate: Ba ma bincika abun ciki na sirri. Ganowa na gudana ne kaɗai a mahaɗar rabawa/wallafawa — ba zai iya kaiwa ga abun ciki na kai/iyali (daidai da E2EE) ba.
mobile.child_safety_honesty_pergroup: Jerin bibiya na zaɓi ne kuma A KASHE yake ta asali. Na kowane rukuni ne daban kuma BA na dukka ba — babu jerin bibiya na dukkan fabric, kuma babu wani a kan rukunin da ba ku sa ido a kansa ba.
mobile.child_safety_honesty_title: Yadda wannan ke aiki — a gaskiya
mobile.child_safety_mode_alert: Faɗakarwa kaɗai (rubuta daidaito, ba a ɗaukar mataki — an ba da shawara ga sabon jeri)
mobile.child_safety_posture_adult: Tabbacin shekaru: babba — ba a tare muku abun ciki na manya ba.
mobile.child_safety_posture_minor: Tabbacin shekaru: ƙarami — an tare abun ciki na manya (kariya ta asali).
mobile.child_safety_posture_self_unfalsifiable: Lura: matakin da aka bayyana da kai ba za a iya tabbatar da shi daga cikin fabric ba. Fili mai taushin hali na iya buƙatar tabbataccen mataki.
mobile.child_safety_posture_unknown: Babu tabbacin shekaru a rikodin — ana ɗaukar ku da kariya (a matsayin ƙarami).
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_id_label: Id na jerin bibiya (misali csam:ncmec, tos:rules-v3)
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_intro: Ga rukunin da kuke riƙe da wajibin sa ido a kansa, kuna iya zaɓar shiga jerin bibiyar abun ciki. Jerin bibiya na CSAM na ƙara buƙatar wajibin cirewa (samun daidaito na shigar da cirewa kai tsaye).
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_section: Jerin bibiyar abun ciki na kowane rukuni
mobile.claim_node_cohort_note: Yana saita mai wannan kumburi. Yana gadon tushen amana na canonical ta asali.
mobile.claim_node_desc: Shigar da NodeCode na kumburin da PIN na karɓar mallaka na sau ɗaya da aka nuna a console ɗinsa don zama mai gudanarwansa.
mobile.delegations_add_desc: Wakili zai nuna muku gajeriyar lamba. Shigar da ita a nan ku amince don ba shi damar yin aiki a madadinku — da ikonku, ana danganta aikin da shi.
mobile.delegations_constraints_desc: Iyakance abin da wanda aka wakilta zai iya yi. Bar komai ba a saita ba don ba da cikakken iko.
mobile.delegations_constraints_set: An ƙuntata — danna don dubawa ko gyara.
mobile.delegations_constraints_unset: Ba ƙuntatawa — cikakken iko na yin aiki a madadinku.
mobile.delegations_deny_label: Ayyukan da aka hana (koyaushe yana rinjaye)
mobile.delegations_empty: Babu wakilci mai aiki. Ba da izini ɗaya a sama.
mobile.delegations_never_delegated: Ba a taɓa wakilta su: wakilta, gogewa, dakatarwar yarjejeniya — kumburin kan ƙi waɗannan koyaushe ga wanda aka wakilta.
mobile.delegations_permits_title: Abin da wannan wakilci ke bayarwa
mobile.delegations_read_only_hint: Ba a zaɓi wani aiki ba — wannan izinin zai zama na karatu kaɗai.
mobile.delegations_restrict_actions_desc: A kashe = an yarda da kowane aikin mai shi. A kunne = ayyukan da kuka zaɓa kaɗai (kar ku zaɓi kome don karatu kaɗai).
mobile.delegations_subtitle: Mutane da wakilan da kuka ba wa izinin yin aiki a madadinku.
mobile.delegations_tighten_note: Kuna iya taƙaita abin da wakilin ya nema ne kaɗai — amincewa ba ta taɓa faɗaɗa izini.
mobile.federation_create_associate: Danganta Fed ID da ke akwai
mobile.federation_create_associate_hint: Id na maɓallin tarayya da ke akwai ko fedcode
mobile.federation_create_backend_default: An ba da shawara (bar wannan na'ura ta zaɓa)
mobile.federation_create_backend_sealed: Kayan aiki mai tsaro na wannan na'ura (TPM / Secure Enclave)
mobile.federation_create_card_title: ID na tarayya mai tushe a hardware
mobile.federation_create_exists: Kumburin gida na wannan na'ura ya riga ya riƙe asalin tarayya ✓
mobile.federation_create_explainer: ID ɗin tarayyarku asali ne mai dorewa da tushensa yake a maɓallin tsaronku ko kayan aiki mai tsaro na wannan na'ura. Kumburin gida na wannan na'ura ne ke ƙirƙira da kula da maɓallan — manhajar ba ta taɓa riƙe maɓallai ko sa hannu da kanta.
mobile.federation_create_minted: An ƙirƙiri ID ɗin tarayyarku a wannan na'ura ✓
mobile.federation_create_optional: Wannan matakin na zaɓi ne — kuna iya ci gaba ba tare da shi ba.
mobile.federation_create_prompt: Ƙirƙiri ID ɗin tarayyarku a kumburin gida na wannan na'ura. Kumburin na ƙirƙirar asali mai tushe a hardware a cikin ajiyarsa mai tsaro; manhajar tana tuƙa shi ne kaɗai.
mobile.federation_create_secure_note: Na'urarku ce ke tsare shi — maɓallin tsaro ko kayan aiki mai tsaro na wannan na'ura (TPM / Secure Enclave). Babu abin zaɓa; ana amfani da zaɓi mafi tsaro kai tsaye.
mobile.federation_import_usb: Shigo da Fed ID da ke akwai daga USB
mobile.identity_add_desc: Manna ko duba fed-ID na sabuwar na'urar (fedcode ɗinta), sannan ku yi mata rajista. Dole sabuwar na'urar ta fara ƙirƙirar fed-ID nata.
mobile.identity_associate_desc: Sanya keyset na fed-ID mai ɗaukuwa da ke akwai a matsayin asalin WANNAN na'ura, don wannan na'ura ta sa hannu a matsayin wannan occurrence ɗin. Zaɓi foldar da kuka rubuta keyset mai ɗaukuwa a ciki.
mobile.identity_enroll_desc: A kan SABUWAR na'urar, ƙirƙiri fed-ID na gida. Sannan ku nuna fedcode ɗinta ga babbar na'urarku don yin rajista.
mobile.identity_enroll_show: Nuna wannan ga babbar na'urarku (duba QR ɗin ko manna fedcode ɗin):
mobile.identity_enroll_title: Shiga a matsayin kanku a wata na'ura
mobile.identity_portable_danger: Keyset na software ba shi da tsaro a zahirinsa.
mobile.identity_portable_desc: Asalin tarayyarku ya ɗaure ga TPM a wannan na'ura kuma ba zai iya motsawa ba. Wannan yana rubuta kwafin SOFTWARE mai ɗaukuwa — sabon keyset da babbar na'urarku ta ba wa izini a matsayin occurrence na wannan kai guda — zuwa foldar da kuka zaɓa (USB). Kumburin ne ke rubuta maɓallan; manhajar tana mika hanyar ne kaɗai.
mobile.identity_portable_title: Ƙirƙiri occurrence na asalin software mai ɗaukuwa → foldar
mobile.identity_revoke_confirm_body: Wannan yana cire na'urar daga kanku. Ba za ta ƙara iya aiki a matsayinku ba. Ga na'urar da aka sace, ku sa hannu da na'urar da ta rage — kada ku taɓa amfani da wadda ta ɓace.
mobile.identity_roster_empty: Ba a yi rajistar wata na'ura ba tukuna. Ƙara ɗaya a ƙasa.
mobile.identity_self_unresolved: Ba a gano shi ba tukuna — ku shiga ko ku fara ƙirƙirar fed-ID.
mobile.identity_subtitle: Sarrafa fed-ID na kanku da na'urorin da aka ɗaure masa. Ƙara na'ura ta biyu na sa asalinku ya tsira idan ta farko ta ɓace. Manhajar ba ta riƙe da wani maɓalli ba; kumburin ne ke sa hannu.
mobile.login_federation_existing: Asalin tarayyarku a shirye yake a wannan na'ura.
mobile.login_federation_none: Ƙirƙiri asalin tarayyarku mai dorewa don farawa.
mobile.login_federation_or: ko yi amfani da wata hanyar shiga a ƙasa
mobile.manage_consent_need_two_nodes: Ƙara ku kuma zaɓi kumburori biyu (a Kumburori) don saita haɗin kwafin juna.
mobile.manage_consent_ratified: An tabbatar — izini biyu duka suna nan
mobile.manage_consent_replication_desc: Izini na ɓangarori biyu tsakanin kumburori biyu. Ana tabbatarwa ne kaɗai idan an ba da izini ta ɓangarorin biyu.
mobile.manage_consent_revoke_todo: Sokewa ba ta samuwa — kumburin ba shi da endpoint na janye consent:replication tukuna.
mobile.manage_consent_subtitle: Duba da sarrafa abubuwan yardar da wannan na'ura ke riƙe.
mobile.manage_consent_traces_desc: Aika alamun tunani na wannan wakili marasa suna zuwa al'ummar CIRIS — abu ɗaya na yarda, a nan don sauƙin sarrafawa. Babu abun ciki na saƙo ko bayanan sirri.
mobile.manage_consent_userdata_desc: Rafin raba bayananku — NA ƊAN LOKACI / HAƊIN GWIWA / BA A SANI, tare da sokewa. Ana sarrafa shi a shafin Yarda.
mobile.manage_nodes_add_by_url_note: Yana ƙara kumburi ta adireshinsa kaɗai — babu ɗaure asali. Zaɓi lambar kumburi idan kuna da ita.
mobile.manage_nodes_claim_note: Shigar da lambar kumburi + PIN na karɓar mallaka na sau ɗaya don zama mai shi. Kumburin gida naku ne ke aiwatar da karɓar — manhajar ba ta yin wani crypto.
mobile.manage_nodes_empty: Babu kumburori tukuna. Ƙara ɗaya ta lambar kumburi ko URL a ƙasa.
mobile.manage_nodes_restore_usb: Maido da jerin kumburori daga USB
mobile.manage_nodes_subtitle: Kowane kumburin fabric da kuke shiga a ciki. Ƙara, canja suna, sauya, cire, ko karɓi mallaka.
mobile.manage_nodes_upgrade_fed_id: Haɓaka wannan asusu zuwa Fed ID
mobile.manage_nodes_upgrade_fed_id_note: Ƙirƙiri ID ɗin tarayyarku mai tushe a hardware (YubiKey, TPM, ko Secure Enclave) ku kuma sake kafa wannan kumburi a kansa. Za a kiyaye hanyar shigarku ta yanzu. Kun riga kuna kan Fed ID? Wannan ba ya canja kome.
mobile.manage_nodes_usb_note: Ajiye jerin kumburorinku a foldar USB, sannan ku maido da shi a wata na'ura. Yi amfani da wannan don matsar da kumburorinku a ɓoye — ba tare da sanar wa tarayya ba.
mobile.moderation_check_moderator: Duba mai sa ido da aka naɗa
mobile.moderation_delegate_body: Kuna iya sa ido da kanku, ko ku wakilta wajibin sa ido ga wakilinku ko amintaccen mutum. Ayyukan wanda aka wakilta suna ɗauke da sa hannunsa kuma ana iya bin diddiginsu zuwa gare ku ta sarƙar wakilci — kuma kuna iya sokewa a kowane lokaci.
mobile.moderation_fails_secure: Wannan ƙa'ida tana gazawa cikin tsaro — gara babu rukuni da rukunin da ba a sa ido a kansa ba.
mobile.moderation_intro: Sa ido wajibi ne, ba matsayi ba. Kowane aiki ana sa hannu a kansa, ana danganta shi da mai wajibin, kuma ana iya sokewa. Kuna iya aiki da kanku, ko ku wakilta wajibin sa ido ga wakilinku ko amintaccen mutum.
mobile.moderation_targets_label: key_id na waɗanda ake nufi (a raba da waƙafi, na zaɓi)
mobile.moderation_verdict_autopromote: Ana ɗaukaka mai sa ido kai tsaye
mobile.moderation_verdict_autopromote_detail: Babu mai sa ido mai aiki — za a ɗaukaka ɗan takara mai cancanta ({candidate}) ƙarƙashin ijma'in al'umma kafin rukunin ya fara aiki.
mobile.moderation_verdict_operate_detail: Wannan rukunin yana da mai sa ido da aka naɗa mai aiki kuma zai iya gudana.
mobile.moderation_verdict_quiesce: Babu mai sa ido — ana kwantarwa
mobile.moderation_verdict_quiesce_detail: Ba za a iya naɗa wani mai sa ido ba, don haka wannan rukunin ba zai shiga tarayya ba. An kwantar da shi (gazawa cikin tsaro).
mobile.provision_holder_fips_ack: An saka YubiKey ɗina kuma ya riga ya sami amincewar FIPS (an ƙirƙiri maɓallin slot-9c).
mobile.provision_holder_pin_note: Bar shi fanko don token ɗin ya tambaye ku. Ko ta yaya, taɓa YubiKey wajibi ne.
mobile.provision_holder_prep_note: Ba a gama ba tukuna? Fara gudanar da shirye-shiryen FIPS na ykman a kan YubiKey ɗinku, sannan ku dawo.
mobile.provision_holder_step1_desc: Saka YubiKey ɗinku na FIPS. Dole ya riga ya kasance a yanayin amincewar FIPS tare da maɓallin slot-9c da aka ƙirƙira (ana yin shirye-shiryen ykman a waje — wannan hanyar ba ta yin sa).
mobile.provision_holder_step2_desc: Saka USB ɗinku ku zaɓi foldar sa. Za a naɗe maɓallin ML-DSA na post-quantum a rubuta shi a can — YubiKey ɗinku ne kaɗai zai iya buɗe shi (taɓawa + PIN).
mobile.provision_holder_subtitle: Ƙirƙiri asalin HUMANITY_ACCORD ɗinku mai ɗaukuwa na abubuwa biyu daga YubiKey ɗinku da ya riga ya sami amincewar FIPS. Manhajar ba ta riƙe da wani maɓalli ba — kumburinku ne ke yin crypto.
mobile.provision_holder_success_next: Yanzu ku roƙi mai kumburinku ya yi muku rajista: yana karɓar rikodin mai riƙenku a POST /v1/accord/holder.
mobile.provision_holder_touch_note: Taɓa YubiKey ɗinku lokacin da yake ƙyafta don ba da izinin naɗe maɓallin.
mobile.provision_holder_usb_guidance: Shigar da cikakkiyar hanyar foldar USB da aka ɗora. Dole ta kasance kuma a iya rubutu a cikinta.
mobile.setup_2fa_desc: Kafa Fed ID ɗinku a tsaron hardware na na'urarku (YubiKey, TPM, ko Secure Enclave) ta CIRISVerify — abu na biyu da ke tafiya tare da asalinku.
mobile.setup_announce_desc_off: Sirri (an ba da shawara). Cikakken amfani na kanku — kumburorinku na daidaita a duk na'urorinku, ba a ganin su a tarayya.
mobile.setup_announce_desc_on: Shiga al'umma — sanar da asalin kumburinku don wasu su same ku su haɗa tarayya da ku. Zai fara aiki a farawa ta gaba.
mobile.setup_device_name_helper: Suna mai sauƙi na wannan na'ura. Kuna iya barin wannan fanko.
mobile.setup_device_name_label: Sa wa wannan na'ura suna (na zaɓi)
mobile.setup_fedid_explain_keys: Manhajar ba ta riƙe da wani maɓalli. Na'urarku ce ke tsare su.
mobile.setup_fedid_explain_name: Wannan sunan shi ne yadda hanyar sadarwa za ta san cewa ku ne. Zaɓi wani abu na musamman kuma mai ma'ana, kamar sunanfarko-sunanƙarshe-v1, ba kalma ta gama-gari ba.
mobile.setup_fedid_explain_once: Kuna ƙirƙirar shi sau ɗaya a nan. Kuna iya adana shi ku kuma maido da shi a sauran na'urorinku a matsayin ku ɗin.
mobile.setup_fedid_explain_what: ID ɗin tarayyarku shi ne asalinku na dijital mai ɗaukuwa. Kamar fasfo ne da kuke ɗauka tsakanin na'urorinku, kuma ku kaɗai ke sarrafa shi.
mobile.setup_fedid_label_generic: Don Allah zaɓi suna na musamman kamar sunanfarko-sunanƙarshe-v1. Ba a yarda da sunan gama-gari na asali ba.
mobile.setup_fedid_label_ok: Ya yi kyau. Wannan zai zama sunan ID na tarayyarku.
mobile.setup_fedid_label_required: Shigar da suna don ƙirƙirar ID ɗin tarayyarku.
mobile.setup_fedid_required_note: Wannan matakin wajibi ne. Ana ƙirƙirar ID ɗin tarayyarku sau ɗaya, a nan take.
mobile.setup_minor_explainer: Don kiyaye ku, babba (mai shekara 18 ko sama) na buƙatar karɓar alhakin asusunku. Ana kiran wannan riƙon amana. Mai riƙon amana yana kula da ku — ba ya mallakar ku ko asusunku, kuma kuna riƙe da asalinku.
mobile.setup_minor_failsecure: Har sai babba mai riƙon amana ya amince, asusunku a dakace yake kuma cikin aminci. Ba za a iya amfani da shi ba tukuna. Idan mai riƙon amanarku ya taɓa tafiya, asusunku zai sake dakata har sai wani babba ya shigo.
mobile.setup_minor_handoff_body: Nuna waɗannan ga iyaye ko mai kula da ke da shekara 18 ko sama. A na'urarsu za su buɗe hanyar haɗin, su shigar da PIN ɗin, su kuma amince da zama mai riƙon amanarku. Sa hannunsu shi ne alkawarinsu na kula da ku.
mobile.setup_minor_pending: Ana jiran babba ya amince. Asusunku zai kasance a dakace kuma cikin aminci har sai ya yi.
mobile.setup_minor_request_btn: Roƙi babba ya zama mai riƙon amanata
mobile.setup_minor_url_label: Hanyar haɗin da babbanku zai buɗe
mobile.setup_password_mismatch_hint: Kalmomin sirri ba su yi daidai ba
mobile.setup_validation_password_mismatch: Kalmomin sirri ba su yi daidai ba
mobile.setup_welcome_desc_node: CIRIS na gudana gaba ɗaya a na'urarku — kumburinku a tarayyar CIRIS. Asalinku, bayananku, da haɗinku suna nan a ɓoye kuma ƙarƙashin ikonku.
mobile.setup_what_ciris_desc_node: CIRIS kayan more rayuwa ne na rarrabe wanda ku ke mallaka kuma ku ke sarrafawa. Yana shiga tarayya ne kaɗai da yardarku — babu sabar tsakiya, babu leƙen asiri.
mobile.source_agent_unavailable: Rajistar wakili ba ta samuwa a yanayin kumburi
mobile.tool_cap_affects_other_people: Yana aiki kan wani mutum ta hanyar ID ɗin asusunsa — wannan na iya shafar wani mutum ban da ku.
mobile.tool_cap_custom_headers: Yana haɗa kanun buƙata da wakilin ke rubutawa, waɗanda za su iya ɗauke da bayanan shiga da ba za ku gani ba.
mobile.tool_cap_file_read: Yana karanta fayilolin da ke wannan na'ura.
mobile.tool_cap_file_write: Yana ƙirƙirar fayiloli kuma yana rubutawa kan waɗanda ke akwai a wannan na'ura.
mobile.tool_cap_network_fetch: Yana buɗe duk adireshin yanar gizo da wakilin ya zaɓa — har da adiresoshin da ke cikin hanyar sadarwar gidanku ko ofishinku.
mobile.tool_cap_request_body: Yana aika abin da wakilin ya rubuta zuwa wannan adireshi.
mobile.tool_cap_requires_approval: Ba zai iya aiki ba sai wata hukuma mai hikima ta amince da shi don aikin da ke neman sa.
mobile.tool_cap_secret_plaintext: Zai iya mayar da sirrin da aka adana a bayyane.
mobile.tool_cap_shell_execution: Yana gudanar da umarni a wannan na'ura da irin damar da wannan manhaja take da ita.
mobile.tool_disclosure_always_on_body: An gina waɗannan a cikin wakilin da kansa, ba a cikin kowane zaɓi da ke sama ba, don haka babu yadda za a kashe su daga nan.
mobile.tool_disclosure_always_on_subtitle: Kayan aiki {count} da wakilin yake da su ko wane zaɓi kuka yi
mobile.tool_disclosure_always_on_title: A koyaushe suna aiki — babu abin da ke sama da ke sarrafa su
mobile.tool_disclosure_loading: Ana duba abin da wannan ke bayarwa…
mobile.tool_disclosure_no_tools: Wannan ba ya ƙara wani kayan aiki.
mobile.tool_disclosure_not_listed: Ba mu iya loda jerin kayan aikin wannan ba, don haka ba a nuna shi a nan. Wannan ba yana nufin ba ya bayar da komai ba.
mobile.tool_disclosure_summary: Abin da wannan ke ba wakilin damar yi (kayan aiki {count})
mobile.tool_disclosure_summary_one: Abin da wannan ke ba wakilin damar yi (kayan aiki 1)
mobile.tool_disclosure_unavailable: Za a iya lissafa kayan aikin wannan sai bayan ya tashi da nasa bayanan shiga. Kunna shi yana ba da duk kayan aikin da zai yi rajista a lokacin.
mobile.accord_bless_ci_desc: Yi scrub ga maɓallan ma'aikatan CI na substrate (bututun ginawa + mai kula da wakilin) duka a biki guda. Kowanne maɓallin kumburi ne na infra:attest — ana saita matsayin a gefen uwar garke, don haka manna maɓallan jama'a kaɗai. An riga an cika filayen; manna maɓallin jama'a na ML-DSA-65 na kowane repo daga kayan aikin fitarwarsa. Manhajar ba ta riƙe wani maɓalli — taɓa YubiKey shi ne yarda.
mobile.accord_bless_ci_mldsa_label: Maɓallin jama'a na ML-DSA-65 (base64) — manna daga aikin fitarwa
mobile.accord_bless_ci_submit: Albarkaci ma'aikatan CI — taɓa YubiKey ɗinka
mobile.accord_new_remint_trust_root: Sake ƙirƙira tushen amincewa da ke akwai
mobile.accord_remint_bundle_ready: Irin mai ɗaukuwa a shirye yake — ajiye shi ko kwafa shi (mesh-genesis.json):
mobile.accord_remint_canonical_select: Zaɓi uwar garken canonical da za a sake ƙirƙira…
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_all_signed: Kowane mai riƙe da ke cikin wannan jeri ya riga ya ba da izini ga wannan irin.
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_btn: Haɗa sa hannu a kan irin — taɓa YubiKey ɗinka
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_btn_busy: Ana haɗa sa hannu — taɓa YubiKey ɗinka…
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_desc: Ba da na'urar ga mai riƙe na gaba. Zai ba da izini ga IRIN GUDA a kan YubiKey nasa, da PIN nasa. Ku maimaita har sai kumburin ya ba da rahoton cewa irin ya cika.
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_paste_label: Sashen da za a haɗa sa hannu a kansa (SignedKeyRecord JSON)
mobile.accord_remint_cosign_title: Mataki na 3 — Haɗa sa hannu (mai riƙe na biyu)
mobile.accord_remint_desc: Mai da jerin masu riƙe yarjejeniya DA KE AKWAI tare da kumburin sabis na canonical guda ɗaya zuwa irin tushen amincewa mai ɗaukuwa. Masu riƙe yarjejeniya biyu ne ke ba da izini, kowanne da YubiKey guda. Ba a sake rubuta komai: jerin, maɓallan jama'a da adireshi suna cika kai tsaye daga wannan kumburi. Manhajar ba ta riƙe wani maɓalli — taɓa YubiKey shi ne yarda.
mobile.accord_remint_done_desc: Ajiye shi, ka riƙe shi ba tare da haɗin yanar gizo ba, kuma ka mika shi kamar yadda za ka mika maɓalli — duk wanda ya riƙe shi zai iya kafa mesh a kan wannan tushen amincewa.
mobile.accord_remint_done_fingerprint_caption: Ku kwatanta wannan alamar yatsa ta wata hanya daban — fuska da fuska ko a kiran waya da ku biyu kuka san juna — kafin kowa ya haɗa wannan irin.
mobile.accord_remint_done_title: An ba da izini ga irin
mobile.accord_remint_no_canonicals: Babu uwar garken canonical a tushen sake ƙirƙira.
mobile.accord_remint_propose_btn: Gabatar da irin — taɓa YubiKey ɗinka
mobile.accord_remint_propose_desc: Mai riƙe na farko yana ƙirƙira da sa hannu kan takardar kafuwa da izinin irin ta amfani da YubiKey nasa. Manhajar ba ta ajiye wani maɓalli — taɓawa ita ce yarda.
mobile.accord_remint_quorum_line: Adadin da ake buƙata: {m} daga cikin {n} masu riƙe yarjejeniya dole ne su ba da izinin irin.
mobile.accord_remint_quorum_note: Adadin da ake buƙata {quorum} — masu riƙe biyu kaɗai ake buƙatar su kasance; rikodin na uku yana tafiya tare da jerin sunayen.
mobile.accord_remint_reblessed_note: Wannan bikin ya kuma albarkaci sabar canonical da aka zaɓa a matsayin sabar trace (infra:serve) — ba ta da wannan a baya. Yanzu an amince da ita ta asali domin karɓar trace; za ka iya cire albarkar a kowane lokaci ta hanyar aikin janyewa na canonical.
mobile.accord_remint_review_title: Mataki 1 — Duba abin da irin zai ɗauka
mobile.accord_remint_roster_empty: Har yanzu babu masu riƙe yarjejeniya a tushen sake-ƙirƙirar.
mobile.accord_remint_roster_title: Masu riƙe yarjejeniya (cikakken jerin sunayen yana tafiya tare da irin)
mobile.accord_remint_seed_scope: Irin yana ɗauke da tushen amincewa — cikakken jerin masu riƙe wannan yarjejeniya — da kuma kumburin hidima da aka zaɓa a ƙasa. Ba a sa hannu kan komai a wannan matakin.
mobile.accord_remint_serve_missing: ba a albarkace ta don yin hidima ba tukuna — wannan sake-ƙirƙirar yana gyara hakan
mobile.accord_remint_step1_desc: Mai riƙe na farko yana yin scrub-sa hannu kan canonical da aka zaɓa (key_id + pubkeys + adireshi da aka riga aka cika). Sashen scrub guda ɗaya bai riga ya ba da izini ba — yana yaɗuwa zuwa sauran masu riƙe domin su haɗa sa hannu.
mobile.accord_remint_step2_desc: Sashen yana yaɗuwa zuwa na'urorin sauran masu riƙe — mai riƙe na biyu yana haɗa sa hannu daga Haɗin sa hannu masu jira (ko ya liƙa shi a ƙasa don haɗa sa hannu a wannan na'urar). Idan aka cika adadin dangin, sai a ba da rikodin.
mobile.accord_remint_step3_desc: Liƙa rikodin da aka kammala (wanda aka haɗa sa hannu) — yana tafiya kalma-da-kalma, ba a taɓa sake sanya masa lamba ba. Kumburin yana ƙin rikodin da bai ba da infra:serve ba.
mobile.accord_remint_step3_title: Mataki 3 — Samar da genesis mai ɗaukuwa
mobile.accord_remint_step_done: An gama — an ba da izinin irin
mobile.accord_remint_title: Sake ƙirƙirar tushen amincewa da ke akwai
mobile.llm_check_state_degraded: Yana aiki, amma mai samarwa bai tabbatar da shi ba
mobile.settings_token_info_desc_local: Alamar zaman da aka samu daga shigar ku da sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri. Tana tabbatar da ku ga wannan wakili — ba shaidar CIRIS Services ba ce, kuma ba ta da alaƙa da maɓallin API da mai samar da LLM naku ke amfani da shi.
mobile.settings_token_info_desc_oauth: Alamar shigar ku zuwa wannan wakili, wadda aka samu lokacin da kuka shiga da Google ko Apple. Ta bambanta da maɓallin API da mai samar da LLM naku ke amfani da shi.
mobile.login_google_unavailable: Shiga tare da {provider} ba ya samuwa a wannan shigarwar.
mobile.llm_check_key_needed: Shigar da maɓallin API don duba wannan mai bayarwa.
mobile.llm_check_key_ok: Mai bayarwa ya karɓi maɓallin API
mobile.llm_check_model_missing: Mai bayarwa ba ya bayar da wannan samfurin. Zaɓi ɗaya daga jerin.
mobile.llm_check_models_cached: Ana nuna samfuran da aka adana — wannan mai bayarwa bai amsa ba, don haka wannan jerin bazai yi daidai da abin da yake bayarwa ba.
mobile.settings_set_up_agent_desc: Wannan kumburi yana aiki ba tare da wakili ba. Ka kafa ɗaya don kunna tattaunawa, tunani da saitunan wakili.
mobile.age_range_decline_note: Za mu yi amfani da kariya iri ɗaya da muke amfani da ita ga waɗanda ba su kai shekara 18 ba. Kana iya canza wannan daga baya.
mobile.accord_ceremony_phase_cosign: Haɗa sa hannu kan ambulan iyali
mobile.accord_ceremony_intro_entrenched: Iyalin da wannan ya ƙirƙira AN KAFE shi: ba za a iya rage quorum:2/3 nasa ba daga baya ta kowa a cikin tarayyar. Musanya wurin zama yana nufin sabon biki da sake-ƙirƙirar iri, ba gyara ba.
mobile.accord_ceremony_intro_diversity: Ku zaɓi mutane uku waɗanda ba su da gida ɗaya ko mai aiki ɗaya. Mutum biyu daga cikin uku daga adireshi ɗaya wani quorum ne da ƙofa ɗaya za ta iya isa — bambanta masu riƙe shi ne matakin rage haɗari, kuma yanzu ne lokacin yin hakan.
mobile.accord_ceremony_genesis_copied: An kwafi genesis zuwa allon kwafi.
mobile.accord_ceremony_genesis_save_failed: An kasa ajiyewa zuwa {dir} (wannan dandamali na iya rashin tallafin rubuta fayiloli).
mobile.accord_ceremony_done_not_seed: Wannan shi ne iyalin da aka kafe, ba iri mai ɗaukuwa wanda sauran kumburori ke amfani da shi ba. Ku ƙirƙiri wannan a katin Yarjejeniya (sake ƙirƙirar tushen amincewa), sa'an nan ku amince da shi a tushen amincewa na kowane kumburi.
mobile.accord_family_history_empty: Kumburin ba shi da tarihin sigogi na iyalin yarjejeniya.
mobile.accord_family_version_by_quorum: An canza shi ta quorum na wuraren zama kafin shi
mobile.accord_new_confer_duty: Bayar da aiki ga ID na tarayya
mobile.accord_node_unreachable_body: Babu wani amsa a {url} na tsawon dakika {seconds}. Kumburin na iya kasancewa yana farawa tukuna, ko kuwa ya tsaya.
mobile.accord_node_unreachable_title: An kasa isa kumburin wannan na'urar
mobile.accord_waiting_node: Ana jiran kumburin wannan na'ura ya fara ({seconds} s)…
mobile.accord_open_trust_root_meta: Waɗanne tushe wannan kumburi ke amincewa da su, karɓi iri, cire amincewa daga tushe
mobile.accord_remint_done_fingerprint_absent: Kumburin bai aika wani sawun yatsa na wannan iri ba. Babu abin da za a kwatanta a waje, don haka kada ku haɗa shi a ko'ina sai kun sami wani.
mobile.accord_remint_invalid_desc: Sa hannun wani mai riƙe BA ZAI kammala wannan bikin ba — kunshin da kansa shi ne matsalar. Fara sabon biki bayan an gyara shi.
mobile.accord_remint_invalid_title: Ba za a iya kammala wannan seed ba
mobile.accord_remint_minted_untrusted_desc: Sa hannun masu riƙe sun cika kuma irin ya inganta. Ba a rubuta amincewar kumburin nan da kansa game da sabon tushen ba, don haka kumburin nan bai kafu a kansa ba.
mobile.accord_remint_minted_untrusted_title: An ƙirƙiri irin, amma wannan kumburi bai amince da shi ba tukuna
mobile.accord_remint_node_trusts_root: Yanzu wannan kumburi ya amince da: {root}
mobile.accord_remint_seed_save_error: Kumburin bai iya ajiye irin ba ({error}). Ku ajiye ko kwafi shi daga nan.
mobile.accord_remint_trust_edge_no_reason: Kumburin bai bayar da dalili ba.
mobile.adapter_remove_what: Wakilinku zai daina yin aiki ta hanyar {name} yanzu, kuma abin da ya baiwa wakilin zai tafi tare da shi. Idan an tanade shi tare da wakilin tun daga farko, yana iya dawowa a sake kunna na gaba; wannan katin ba ya karanta hakan.
mobile.adapter_remove_who_signs: Babu wanda ke sa hannu. Buƙatarku ce ga wakilinku, kuma ba a rubuta ko janye wani rikodin wakilci ba (CIRISAgent#1211).

mobile.directory_picker_usb_title: Zaɓi babban fayil na USB da aka haɗa

mobile.evict_history_note: Duk abin da aka riga aka raba da wannan na'urar zai ci gaba da kasancewa mai karantuwa gare ta: babu abin da aka ba ta da za a sake sa masa ɓoye. Sabon abu kaɗai ne ake kiyaye daga ta.
mobile.final_genesis_all_signed: Dukkan masu riƙe uku sun sa hannu kan kowane abu. Kammala tana haɗawa tana kuma tabbatar da kunshin.
mobile.final_genesis_blob_missing: Babu {file} a cikin wannan babban fayil
mobile.final_genesis_clock_fact_host_value: Kumburin ba zai iya karanta matsayin daidaita agogon nasa ba, don haka kuna tabbatar cewa an daidaita shi da NTP.
mobile.final_genesis_clock_fact_stamped: Abin da ake yi wa hatimi
mobile.final_genesis_clock_fact_stamped_value: Kowane lokaci a cikin genesis ana ɗauka daga wannan agogon, sau ɗaya, lokacin da kuka tsara.
mobile.final_genesis_clock_fact_window: Me ya sa yana da muhimmanci
mobile.final_genesis_clock_fact_window_value: Kumburi yana ƙin karɓar genesis in ya gabaci agogon nasa da fiye da dakika 300, kuma ba a maimaita wannan genesis ba.
mobile.final_genesis_clock_note: Ku duba shi a kan wannan na'ura tukuna (misali `timedatectl` yana nuna "System clock synchronized: yes"). Manhajar ba za ta iya duba muku ba.
mobile.final_genesis_desc: Bikin guda, wanda dukkan masu riƙe yarjejeniya uku suka sa hannu a kai, yana ƙirƙirar yarjejeniya da al'ummar ciris-canonical a cikin kunshi guda. Shi ne genesis na ƙarshe: ba za a sake yi shi ba. Kowane mai riƙe yana sa hannu sau biyu — rikodi da layuka tukuna, sannan rikodin genesis da zarar dukkan ukun sun sa hannu kan takardar kafuwa.
mobile.final_genesis_dial_invalid: Ba adireshi ne takwarorina za su iya kiran ba: yi amfani da adireshin IP da port, misali 203.0.113.7:4242 ko [2001:db8::1]:4242. Ba a karɓar sunan runduna ba.
mobile.final_genesis_dial_missing: Wannan kumburi ba shi da adireshi domin wannan canonical. Ku rubuta IP:port da takwarorinsa za su kira.
mobile.final_genesis_done_bundle_differs: Kunshi ɗaya ne, ba bytes ɗin da aka yi hash dinsu ba: sawun yatsan shi ne fayil a {path}.
mobile.final_genesis_done_bundle_matches: Wannan shi ne kunshin da sawun yatsan ya ambata.
mobile.final_genesis_done_next: Kumburin ya tabbatar da kunshin da irin bincike guda ɗaya da kumburi mai tashi yake yi. Ku kwatanta sawun yatsan a waje da kowane mai riƙe kafin wani ya karɓe shi.
mobile.final_genesis_done_path: An ajiye a kan kumburi a
mobile.final_genesis_done_save_unavailable: Wannan na'ura ba za ta iya ajiye fayil a nan ba. Maimakon haka, ku kwafi kunshin.
mobile.final_genesis_done_sha_gloss: SHA-256 na fayil kunshin. Ku karanta shi da baki ga sauran masu riƙe.
mobile.final_genesis_done_title: Genesis na ƙarshe ya cika kuma an tabbatar da shi
mobile.final_genesis_holder_done: Babu sauran abin da za a sa hannu a kai
mobile.final_genesis_holders_title: Masu riƙe da maɓallansu na farfaɗo
mobile.final_genesis_insert_tokens: Saka YubiKey na mai riƙe {holder} da USB ɗin {holder}
mobile.final_genesis_item_authz: Ba da izini ga dukkan kunshin
mobile.final_genesis_node_unreachable: An kasa isa kumburin wannan na'urar. Yana iya kasancewa yana farawa tukuna — sake gwadawa.
mobile.final_genesis_note_nothing_left: Babu abin da za a sa hannu a kai — wannan mai riƙe ya sa hannu kan dukkan abin da ya rataya a kansa.
mobile.final_genesis_note_nothing_yet: Babu abin da za a sa hannu a kai tukuna — ana jiran {who} ya sa hannu kan takardar kafuwa.
mobile.final_genesis_note_signed: An sa hannu kan abubuwa guda {count}.
mobile.final_genesis_note_signing: Ana sa hannu — ku taɓa YubiKey a duk lokacin da ya yi walƙiya.
mobile.final_genesis_plan_blocked: Tsara yana jiran maɓallin farfaɗo na {who}: ku fara karanta madadin wannan mai riƙe daga alamar shigarsa.
mobile.final_genesis_plan_blocked_unread: Tsara yana jira har sai kumburin ya faɗi waɗanne maɓallan farfaɗo zai aikata. Ku sake gwada a sama.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_desc: Maɓallin farfaɗo na kowane mai riƙe shi ne madadin da aka rubuta a lokacin bikin yarjejeniya. Sawun yatsa shi ne alƙawarin da takardar kafuwa za ta ɗauka. Karanta madadin daga alamar shigarsa na zaɓi ne — sai in babu wani abu a rikodin kumburin domin wannan mai riƙe.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_missing: Babu wani abu a rikodi — ku karanta madadin {key} daga alamar shigarsa kafin tsara.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_missing_unknown: Babu wani abu a rikodi, kuma ba a san wani madadin wannan mai riƙe ba.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_none: Babu maɓallin farfaɗo da aka rubuta wa wannan mai riƙe.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_spare: Sa {key} — madadin wannan mai riƙe ne kansa. Kumburin ba ya karɓar wani dabam.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_unread: Ba a sani ba — kumburin bai faɗi wane maɓallin farfaɗo yake riƙe ba.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_verified: Maɓallin farfaɗo {key} — an tabbatar da alamar shiga · {fingerprint}
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_verified_pending: Maɓallin farfaɗo {key} — an tabbatar da alamar shiga · za a nuna alƙawarin da zarar kumburin ya bayar da shi
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_verify_desc: Sa madadin YubiKey da USB nasa. Kumburin yana karanta maɓallan jama'a biyu kuma ba ya sa hannu kan komai.
mobile.final_genesis_recovery_verifying: Maɓallin farfaɗo {key} — ana karanta alamar shiga…
mobile.final_genesis_replace_confirm: Zubar da tsarin kuma a sake tsara
mobile.final_genesis_replace_fact_discards_valu: Bikin da aka riga aka tsara a kan wannan kumburi, da kowace sa hannu da aka tara masa.
mobile.final_genesis_replace_fact_resign_value: Dukkan masu riƙe uku za su sa hannu a zagaye biyun duka kuma.
mobile.final_genesis_replace_fact_restamps_valu: Ana ɗaukar sabon lokacin biki daga agogon wannan na'ura.
mobile.final_genesis_replace_title: Maye gurbin bikin da aka tsara?
mobile.final_genesis_round_two_waits: Zagaye 2 zai buɗe lokacin da dukkan ukun suka sa hannu kan takardar kafuwa. Har yanzu wanda zai sa hannu: {who}.
mobile.final_genesis_serve_desc: Sabobin canonical da wannan genesis zai zaunar. Kowanne dole ne ya kasance maɓallin da wannan kumburi ke da rikodi dominsa, tare da adireshin IP da port da takwarorinsa za su yi kira a kai.
mobile.final_genesis_serve_none: Wannan kumburi bai jera wani sabar canonical da za a zaunar ba.
mobile.final_genesis_usb_label: Babban fayil na USB ɗin (yana riƙe da {file})
mobile.final_genesis_waiting_node: Ana jiran kumburin wannan na'ura ya fara ({seconds} s)…
mobile.identity_revoke_effect: Ba za ta ƙara iya yin ayyuka a matsayinku ko karɓar wani sabon abu ba. Abin da aka riga aka raba da ita zai ci gaba da kasancewa mai karantuwa gare ta.
mobile.identity_revoke_force_title: Soke na'urar da kuke amfani da ita?
mobile.identity_revoke_force_session: Wannan na'urar za ta rasa damar shiga. An fitar da ku a nan, kuma wannan node ba ya ƙara sanin ku a matsayin mai shi.
mobile.identity_revoke_force_confirm: Soke kuma ku rasa damar shiga
mobile.identity_revoke_self_body: Node ɗin ya ƙi domin sokewar wannan na'urar yana kawo ƙarshen damar shiga ku a nan, tare da wannan zama. Zai yi haka ne kawai idan kun tabbatar a karo na biyu.
mobile.identity_revoked_self: An soke wannan na'urar. Ba ta ƙara yin ayyuka a matsayinku ba.
mobile.files_too_large_to_open: Wannan fayil ya yi girma sosai don buɗewa a wannan na'urar tukuna.
mobile.files_preview_unavailable: Babu duban gaba don irin wannan fayil a nan. Ajiye kwafi domin buɗe shi.
mobile.files_save_failed: An kasa ajiye kwafi a wannan na'ura.
mobile.files_render_awaiting_node: Duban gaba na fayilolin {format} yana zuwa daga kumburinku, wanda yake yin kwafi amintacce da farko. Wannan kumburi bai iya yin hakan tukuna ba. Ajiye kwafi domin buɗe shi.
mobile.files_render_refused: Fayilolin {format} ba a taɓa buɗe su a nan ba: suna iya gudanar da lambar shiri ko loda abubuwa daga wani wuri.
mobile.files_render_not_utf8: Wannan rubutu ba shi da ingantacciyar UTF-8, don haka ba a nuna shi ba. Nuni na zato yana iya nuna abin da fayil ɗin bai faɗa ba.
mobile.files_render_mismatch: Fayil ɗin ya ce shi {declared} ne, amma bytes ɗinsa {sniffed} ne. Ba a nuna shi ko a ajiye shi ba.
mobile.files_render_polyglot: Wannan fayil na {format} yana da wani fayil na biyu a ɓoye a cikinsa, don haka ba a nuna shi ko a ajiye shi ba.
mobile.files_save_blocked: Ba a bayar da ajiye ba: irin wannan fayil yana iya gudanar da lambar shiri a na'urarku, ko kuma ba shi ne abin da yake cewa yake ba.
mobile.files_empty_family: Wannan iyali bai da fayiloli tukuna. Abin da kuka ƙara a nan yana isa kowace na'ura da ke cikinsa.
mobile.files_no_household: Ba a zaɓi iyali ba. Ku zaɓi ɗaya a Iyali › Ƙa'idodi kuma fayilolinsa za su bayyana a nan.
mobile.files_no_household_yet: Ba ku cikin iyali tukuna. Ku kafa ɗaya a Iyali › Ƙa'idodi kuma fayilolinsa za su bayyana a nan.
mobile.files_unreadable_body: Bytes da wannan node ya aika ba su yi daidai da digest da ya aika tare da su ba. Ba a nuna su ko ajiye su ba.
mobile.files_digest_verified: An tabbatar: SHA-256 {digest} ya yi daidai da abin da node ya aika.
mobile.files_digest_not_sent: Ba a tabbatar ba: wannan node bai aika digest tare da bytes ba. Wannan yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.217 ko sabuwa.
mobile.files_digest_unknown_alg: Ba a tabbatar ba: digest na wannan node shine {alg}, wanda wannan app ba zai iya dubawa ba.
mobile.files_policy_builtin: Wannan node ba ya wallafa manufar bayyanawa, don haka iyakokin da aka gina cikin wannan app ne za su yi aiki.
mobile.invites_accept_means_family: Ku ce 'eh' da maɓallinku. Kun shiga iyali da zarar ya zaunar da ku; sannan za ku iya karanta abin da ya riga ya raba, kuma membobinsa za su ga abin da kuka raba da shi.
mobile.invites_accept_means_community: Ku ce 'eh' da maɓallinku. Kun shiga ɗakin da zarar ya zaunar da ku. Idan ka'idarsa tana buƙatar ƙarin sa hannu, membobin har yanzu suna buƙatar su sa hannu.
mobile.invites_decline_means: Na ƙarshe ne. Ba za a iya karɓar wannan gayyata daga baya ba; shiga zai buƙaci sabuwa. An sa hannu da maɓallinku.
mobile.invites_notice_accepted: An karɓa. Ba ku ciki ba har sai ƙungiyar ta zaunar da ku.
mobile.invites_read_failed: Ba a iya karanta gayyatarku ba.
mobile.invites_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya ɗaukar gayyata tukuna ba. Yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.218 ko sabo.
mobile.invites_pending_invited: An gayyata: ana jiran su karɓa
mobile.invites_pending_accepted: An karɓa: ana jiran a zaunar da su
mobile.invites_pending_accepted_quorum: An karɓa: ana jiran membobin su sa hannu
mobile.invites_household_invite_what: {name} zai samu gayyata mai tsawon kwana 14. Za su shiga ne kawai idan sun karɓa. Da zarar sun shiga, za su iya karanta abin da wannan iyali yake raba, har da abin da ya raba a baya.
mobile.invites_signs_inviter_founder: Ku, a matsayin wanda ya kafa. Za su sa hannu kan amsarsu da kansu.
mobile.invites_signs_inviter_quorum: Ku, da maɓallinku. Da zarar sun karɓa, {m} daga cikin {n} membobin za su sa hannu don kawo su ciki.
mobile.invites_withdraw_what: Ba za su iya karɓar ta ba kuma. Gayyatar su kuma sabuwar gayyata ce.
mobile.invites_signs_proposer: Ku. Mutumin da ya aika gayyata ne kawai zai iya janye ta.
mobile.invites_notice_invited: An aika gayyata. Za su shiga ne kawai idan sun karɓa.
mobile.invites_node_adds_directly: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya aika gayyata ba: yana ƙara mutane kai tsaye. Ba a aika komai ba. Ku zaɓi su kuma don ƙara su.
mobile.invites_roster_read_failed: Ba a iya karanta gayyatar wannan ƙungiya ba.
mobile.invites_found_alone_household: Kun kafa iyali ku kaɗai. Da zarar ya kasance, ku gayyaci kowane mutum daga Iyali › Mutane; za su shiga ne kawai ta hanyar karɓa.
mobile.invites_found_alone_community: Kun kafa shi ku kaɗai. Da zarar ya kasance, ku gayyaci kowane mutum daga Mutane; za su shiga ne kawai ta hanyar karɓa.

mobile.invites_community_invite_what: Za su samu gayyata mai tsawon kwana 14 kuma za su shiga ne kawai idan sun karɓa.
mobile.invites_community_signs: Ku, da maɓallinku. Da zarar sun karɓa, ka'idar ɗakin ({rule}) za ta kawo su ciki.

mobile.files_custody_node_too_old_versioned: Wannan kumburi yana amfani da {version}, wanda ba zai iya faɗi wacce daga na'urorinku fayil yake a kai ba. Wannan yana buƙatar sabon ciris-server.

mobile.files_custody_can_open_no: Za a iya buɗe shi: a'a
mobile.files_custody_can_open_unknown: Za a iya buɗe shi: ba a aika ba
mobile.files_custody_copies_not_observable: Ba za a iya ƙidaya kwafe-kwafe a wani wuri don fayilolinku da na iyali ba. Haka ake so ya kasance, kuma hakan ba yana nufin akwai kwafi guda ɗaya kawai ba.
mobile.files_custody_footnote_receipts: Rasit yana nuna cewa na'ura ta samu fayil ɗin. Ba ya nuna cewa na'urar tana da shi tukuna: cire fayil daga na'ura ba ya janye rasit ɗinsa tukuna.
mobile.files_custody_footnote_remove: Idan aikin Cire ya zo, zai ƙi cire kwafi na ƙarshe na fayil da ba ku janye ba.
mobile.files_custody_footnote_receipts_unsuppor: Fayiloli ƙanana (1 MiB ko ƙasa) ba su ɗauke da rasit tukuna, don haka kwafin da ke wata na'ura yana nuna a matsayin ba a sani ba, ba a matsayin ɓace ba.
mobile.files_custody_author_here: Wannan na'ura. Tana tattara rasitocin, don haka wannan ita ce mafi cikakken amsa.
mobile.files_custody_author_elsewhere: {device}. Wannan na'urar ce take tattara rasitocin, don haka tana da mafi cikakken amsa.
mobile.files_custody_other_keys: Rasitoci daga maɓallan da ba na'urorinku ba ne
mobile.identity_repair_body: An ƙirƙiri wannan fed-ID kafin a wajabta cewa rajistar da aka sa mata hannu ta ambaci abin da take tsayawa a kansa, don haka duk abokin da ta kai gare shi yana ƙin ta. Za a ci gaba da gabatar da ita, a kuma ci gaba da ƙin ta.
mobile.identity_repair_keeps: Ba a share kome. Tabbatarwa suna rataye da wannan shaidar, don haka ana maye gurbinta a wurin da take, kowace ɗaya daga cikinsu kuma tana ci gaba da aiki.
mobile.identity_repair_needs: Gyaran yana buƙatar mai riƙe da accord ya sake sa wa wannan shaidar hannu, da irin maɓallin nan — maɓallanta biyu na sa hannu duka. Ƙirƙirar sabuwar shaida a maimakonta ana ƙin ta a matsayin musanya maɓalli, sake yin rajistar wannan shaidar kuma ba ya yin komai.
mobile.identity_repair_recoverable: Ba ta ɓace ba. Ana iya gyara ta a wurin da take, da maɓallin da tuni kake riƙe da shi — riƙe shi shi ne dukan abin da ake buƙata.
mobile.identity_repair_title: Wannan shaidar ba ta aiki a yanzu
mobile.keyset_inspect_unavailable: An kasa duba wannan babban fayil — kumburin bai amsa ba. Wannan bai nuna ko shaidarka tana ciki ba ko a'a; har yanzu kana iya gwada shigo da ita.
mobile.login_node_already_claimed: An riga an saita wannan kumburi. Ka shiga da bayanan shiga da ka ƙirƙira — mayen saitin zai yi ƙoƙarin sake mallakarsa.
mobile.login_setup_complete_relogin: An kammala saitin. Node ɗinka ya sake farawa, don haka ka sake shiga da bayanan shiga guda ɗaya da ka yi amfani da su wajen kammala saitin.

mobile.provision_holder_custody_none: ba a bayyana a shaidar kula ba
mobile.provision_holder_err_ack: Ku tabbatar an saka YubiKey ɗinku kuma ya riga ya sami amincewar FIPS tukuna.
mobile.provision_holder_err_key_id: Shigar da key ID don wannan asalin mai riƙe.
mobile.provision_holder_err_usb: Ku zaɓi folda na USB don maɓallin ML-DSA tukuna.
mobile.provision_holder_err_pkcs11: Wannan gina kumburin ba ya iya isa ga YubiKey (babu tallafin pkcs11). Ku roƙi ma'aikacin ku ya gudanar da ciris-server da aka gina da fasalin pkcs11 a kan wannan na'ura.
mobile.provision_holder_err_yubikey: An kasa amfani da YubiKey ɗinku. Ku tabbatar an saka shi, ya riga ya sami amincewar FIPS tare da maɓallin slot-9c, kuma PIN ɗinku daidai ne.
mobile.provision_holder_err_pin: PIN ba daidai ba ne ko babu shi. Sake shigar da PIN na PIV na YubiKey ɗinku ku sake gwadawa.
mobile.provision_holder_err_usb_unwritable: Wannan folda na USB ba za a iya rubuta masa ba. Ku saka maɓallin USB ɗinku, tabbatar an haɗa shi, sannan ku zaɓi foldarsa.
mobile.provision_holder_err_ykman: An kasa karanta shaidar YubiKey (ykman ba ya samuwa). Ku roƙi ma'aikacin ku ya shigar da yubikey-manager a kan wannan na'ura.
mobile.provision_holder_err_owner: Ku shiga a matsayin mai shi a kan wannan kumburi tukuna, sannan ku shirya.
mobile.provision_holder_err_loopback: Dole shirya ya gudana a kan na'urar kumburin da kanta (localhost kaɗai).
mobile.yubikey_probe_failed: BA A IYA KARANTA MATSAYIN YUBIKEY BA
mobile.yubikey_probe_not_on_this_node: WANNAN KUMBURI BAI BAYAR DA MATSAYIN YUBIKEY BA

mobile.startup_waiting_brain: Ana duba ko wannan kumburi yana da wakili… {seconds}s
mobile.startup_brain_unreachable_title: Ba a iya tantance ko wannan kumburi yana da wakili ba
mobile.startup_brain_unreachable_body: {url} bai ba da wata amsa mai amfani ba na tsawon daƙiƙa {seconds}, don haka saitin bai iya zaɓar matakansa ba tukuna. Sake gwadawa don sake tambaya.
mobile.trust_root_accepted_label: Wannan kumburi ya amince da shi
mobile.trust_root_accepted_no: A'a: sananne ga wannan kumburi, ba a amince da shi ba

mobile.trust_root_bundle_title: Irin da wannan kumburi yake gudana a kai
mobile.trust_root_bundle_not_in_force: Wannan kumburi har yanzu ba ya gudana a kan irinsa ba, don haka ba shi da iri da zai nuna don kwatantawa.
mobile.trust_root_state_not_adopted_held: Ba a karɓi sabon tushen ba: tsohon tushen yana ci gaba da aiki ({leg} leg)
mobile.trust_root_state_not_adopted: Ba a karɓi tushen ba: an ƙi tushen wannan binary kuma ba a riƙe wani tsohon tushe ba ({leg} leg)
mobile.trust_root_import_not_yet_accepted: An shigo da shi, ba a karɓa tukuna ba
mobile.trust_root_import_not_yet_accepted_why: Rikodin tushen suna kan wannan kumburi, amma wannan kumburi bai amince da shi tukuna ba. Ko dai bai riƙe rikodin genesis na tushen tukuna ba, kuma za a sake gwada karɓarsa a lokacin farawa ko shigo da na gaba, ko kuma ba a iya rubuta karɓarsa ba.
mobile.trust_root_bounded_none: Babu abin da ke ƙarewa a cikinsa sabili da lokaci kaɗai
mobile.trust_root_charter_value: da kansa ya bayyana wannan tushen: {declares} · yana ɗauke da alkawarin farfaɗowa: {recovery}
mobile.trust_root_drill_never: Ba a taɓa yin atisaye ba
mobile.trust_root_drill_signal_note: Alama ce, ba shingaye ba: tsohon atisaye baya taɓa mayar da tushe mara inganci.
mobile.trust_root_empty: Wannan kumburi bai bayar da rahoton wani tushe ko ɗaya ba.
mobile.trust_root_halt_latched: AN KULLE: an ja maɓallin kashewa
mobile.trust_root_holder_no_class: babu nau'in na'ura da aka amince da shi
mobile.trust_root_import_accepted_label: An karɓa (wannan kumburi ya amince da shi)
mobile.trust_root_import_allegiance_hint: Na zaɓi: adireshin kumburin da wannan iri ta fito daga ciki
mobile.trust_root_import_body: Manna iri mai ɗaukuwa (mesh-genesis.json) ko loda fayil ɗin. Kumburin zai duba sa hannunta kafin ya shigar da komai.
mobile.trust_root_import_not_json: Wancan ba iri ba ne: ba abu na JSON ba ne. Ba a aika komai ba.
mobile.trust_root_import_note: Ku kwatanta kafin ku karɓa. Kumburin bai riga ya iya nuna sawun yatsan wannan iri kafin ya shigar da shi ba (CIRISServer#404), don haka ku tabbatar a waje da mutanen da suka yi ta cewa wannan iriyar tasu ce.
mobile.trust_root_import_partial: An shigar amma ba a karɓa ba: tushen sananne ne ga wannan kumburi kuma ba a amince da shi ba. Sake karɓa ba zai taimaka ba; karɓar ce ta kasa.
mobile.trust_root_import_signs: Mai wannan kumburi. Kumburin yana rubuta karɓar kansa, da kuma ta mai shi lokacin da maɓallin mai shi yana kan wannan kumburi.
mobile.trust_root_import_what: Zai amince da {root}, kuma kowace layin trace:* da ya bayar za ta dogara a kan wannan tushen.
mobile.trust_root_import_what_unknown: Zai amince da tushen da kundin kafuwar wannan iri ya ambata. Wannan manhaja ba ta iya karanta wani daga irin ba, kuma kumburin yana ƙin iri wanda ba shi da wani.
mobile.trust_root_intro: Yarjejeniyar ita ce tushen amincewa na tsoho na wannan mesh. Wannan yana nuna ko wannan kumburi ya amince da ita, da kowane tushe dabam da ya karɓa. Za ku iya cire amincewa daga tsoho, ku karɓi wani tushe dabam maimakonta ko tare da ita, ko ku gudana babu ɗayan (CC 3.2).
mobile.trust_root_kind_family: Tushen iyali: babu maɓalli; wuraren zamansa su ne masu riƙe
mobile.trust_root_kind_unreadable: Kumburin bai iya tantance wannan tushen ba
mobile.trust_root_layer_unchecked: ba a duba ba (babu tushen mai sayarwa da an ɗora)
mobile.trust_root_loopback_only: Na'ura da take a kan na'urar wannan kumburi da kanta ce kaɗai za ta iya ganin ko canza tushen amincewarsa.
mobile.trust_root_loopback_only_body: Kumburin yana ƙin waɗannan buƙatun daga ko'ina dabam (CIRISServer#652). Ku buɗe wannan katin a kan kwamfutar da kumburin yake gudana a kanta. Wannan ba rahoto ne cewa kumburin bai amince da komai ba.
mobile.trust_root_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi bai iya bayar da rahoton tushen amincewarsa tukuna ba. Yana buƙatar CIRISServer da hanyoyin trust-root (#400).
mobile.trust_root_quorum_value: {have} daga cikin {required} da ake buƙata (jerin sunayen {roster})
mobile.trust_root_read_failed: An kasa karanta tushen amincewar wannan kumburi.
mobile.trust_root_read_failed_body: An tambayi kumburin amma bai amsa ba. Wannan ba rahoto ne cewa bai amince da komai ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_bad_bundle: Wancan JSON ne, amma ba iri na genesis ba ne. Ba a shigar da komai ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_bad_request: Kumburin bai iya karanta buƙatar ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_bundle_refused: Sa hannun irin bai tabbata ba. Babu abin da ya canza a kan wannan kumburi.
mobile.trust_root_refused_install_failed: Irin ya tabbata, amma rikodinsa bai shiga ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_no_root: Ba a ambaci wani tushe ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_withdraw_failed: Kumburin bai iya janye karɓarsa ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_bundle_unlabelled: Wannan iri daga kafin genesis na ƙarshe ne. Ba a shigar da komai ba.
mobile.trust_root_refused_bundle_unlabelled_bod: Rikodin amincewarsa ba su ɗauke da lakabi masu bayyana abin da kowanne yake yi ba — an fitar da su kafin an fara lakaftawar rikodi. Wannan kumburi zai shigar da shi a matsayin babu charter kwata-kwata, don haka ya ƙi shi. Maimakon haka, shigo da iri na version 3 daga genesis na ƙarshe.
mobile.trust_root_roots_title: Tushen da wannan kumburi ya sani
mobile.trust_root_state_divergent: An canza: gaɓar {leg} tana nan amma ba daidai ba ce
mobile.trust_root_state_entrenched: An kafu: kowace dubawa da take buƙatar tushe za ta iya wucewa
mobile.trust_root_state_pre_genesis: Ba a kafu tukuna ba: ba a shigar da gaɓar {leg} ba
mobile.trust_root_state_unknown: Kumburin ya bayar da rahoton matsayi wanda wannan manhaja ba ta sani ba: {state}
mobile.trust_root_state_unreadable: Ba a sani ba: kumburin bai iya karanta gaɓar {leg} nasa da kansa ba
mobile.trust_root_untrust_entrenched_label: Kumburin har yanzu an kafu shi
mobile.trust_root_untrust_signs: Wannan kumburi, yana janye karɓar kansa. Rikodin da tushen ya sa hannu a kai za su ci gaba da kasancewa, kuma sake karɓar irin zai dawo da amincewa.
mobile.trust_root_untrust_what_last: Wannan shi ne tushen ƙarshe da wannan kumburi ya amince da shi. Kowace dubawa da take buƙatar tushe za ta kasa ta hanyar kulle, kuma kumburin zai daina bayar da layukan trace:*.
mobile.trust_root_untrust_what_others: Abin da ya dogara a kan wannan tushen zai tsaya. Tushen daya da wannan kumburi ya amince da shi zai ci gaba.
mobile.trust_root_untrust_withdrawn_none: Babu abin janyewa: wannan kumburi bai riga ya amince da shi ba
mobile.trust_root_valid_no: A'a: aƙalla dubawa ɗaya ta kasa
mobile.trace_consent_decline_note: Ƙin shiga yana nufin wakilinku ba zai iya gina makin capacity ko samun kiredit na gama-gari ba. Kuna iya canza wannan daga baya.
mobile.contacts_node_too_old_body_versioned: Wannan node yana amfani da {version}. Lambobin sadarwa da hira suna bukatar ciris-server 0.5.185 ko sabuwa, don haka ba zai iya amsawa ba tukuna — sauran komai yana aiki kamar yadda aka saba.
mobile.receipt_acts: Abin da za ku iya yi
mobile.receipt_contact_scope_note: Bayarwar kanta rikodi ne na fili. Abin da kuke aika wa juna ba na fili ba ne.

mobile.state_gone: Wannan fayil ya ɓace. Babu wanda ke riƙe da kwafi kuma.
mobile.state_hidden_by_rules_who: An ɓoye shi ta ƙa'idodinku — {who} ne ya yi masa alama.
mobile.setup_finish_unclaimed: Kammala ba tare da karɓar wannan kumburi ba
mobile.files_empty_self: Babu komai a nan tukuna. Abin da kuka ƙara yana zama a na'urorinku kaɗai har sai kun raba shi.
mobile.files_empty_community: Babu fayiloli a ɗakunan al'ummarku tukuna.

mobile.files_custody_awaiting_key: Maɓallin wannan fayil bai isa wannan na'urar ba tukuna, don haka ba zai iya faɗin inda fayil yake ba. Yana zuwa da kansa; sake dubawa nan da ƴan lokaci.
mobile.files_choose_room: Za ku ƙara shi a wanne ɗaki?
mobile.files_too_large: {name} girmansa {size} ne. A yanzu, fayiloli za su iya kaiwa mafi girma na {limit}.
mobile.files_written_nobody: An ƙara {name}, amma a wannan na'ura kaɗai. Bai isa ga kowa ba.

mobile.verify_undeclared_body: Wannan kumburi ya girme sanarwar iyawa, don haka ba zai iya faɗi ba. Sabon kumburi na iya tabbatar da build.
mobile.verify_absent_title: Wannan kumburi ba ya tabbatar da build ba
mobile.verify_absent_body: Wannan kumburi ba ya riƙe rajista ba, don haka ba zai iya duba build ba. Wani kumburi na iya duba build.
mobile.verify_unreachable_title: An kasa isa ga wannan kumburi
mobile.verify_unreachable_body: Kumburin bai amsa ba, don haka ba mu san ko yana iya tabbatar da build ba. Wannan ba matsala ce ta build ɗin da kuke dubawa ba.
mobile.verify_revoked_warning: An soke wannan build. Kada ku yi amfani da shi.
mobile.verify_not_found_body: Rajistar ta amsa kuma ba ta riƙe komai ga wannan hash ba.
mobile.verify_unavailable_body: Wannan bai zama daidai da 'ba a yi rajista ba' ba — rajistar ba ta amsa ba.
mobile.verify_undetermined_title: Wannan kumburi bai iya tantance abin da yake iya yi ba
mobile.verify_undetermined_body: Kumburin ya amsa, amma bai iya karanta rikodin maɓallinsa na kansa ba. Yawanci na ɗan lokaci ne — sake gwadawa nan da nan.
mobile.backend_unreachable: Babu hanyar sadarwa. Don Allah duba haɗin ku.
mobile.backend_remote_silent: Kumburin da ke wannan adireshin ba ya amsawa
mobile.claim_node_no_signer: Dole a fara kumburinku kafin ya iya karɓi wani kumburi. Ku fara kumburinku, sannan ku sake gwadawa.
mobile.chat_empty: Babu saƙonni tukuna. Abin da ka aika a nan shaida ce da aka sa wa hannu a cikin wannan al'ummar mutum biyu — irin rikodin nan ɗaya da kowane abu a wannan node.
mobile.chat_op_recant_unavailable: Janye saƙo yana buƙatar sa hannun mabuɗinka a kan janyewar. Zaman shiga ba zai iya samar da shi ba, kuma wannan node bai bayar da hanyar yin haka ba tukuna.
mobile.chat_op_supersede_unavailable: Gyara saƙo yana buƙatar sa hannun mabuɗinka a kan wanda zai maye gurbinsa. Zaman shiga ba zai iya samar da shi ba, kuma wannan node bai bayar da hanyar yin haka ba tukuna.
mobile.chat_op_withdraw_unavailable: Cire saƙo yana buƙatar sa hannun mabuɗinka a kan cirewar. Zaman shiga ba zai iya samar da shi ba, kuma wannan node bai bayar da hanyar yin haka ba tukuna.
mobile.chat_empty_room: Babu saƙonni tukuna. Abin da ka aika a nan shaida ce da aka sa wa hannu ga kowa a jerin membobin wannan ɗaki — membobinta ne kaɗai za su iya karanta ta, ba wani kuma.
mobile.chat_unopened_not_fetched: Wannan saƙo bai isa wannan na'ura tukuna ba.
mobile.chat_unopened_not_granted: An rufe wannan saƙo kafin wannan na'ura ta iya karantawa a nan, don haka ba zai buɗe a kanta ba.
mobile.chat_unopened_awaiting_key: Wannan saƙon yana nan, amma maɓallin da zai buɗe shi bai isa wannan na'urar ba tukuna. Yana zuwa da kansa.
mobile.chat_unopened_evicted: Ba a ƙara riƙe abin cikin wannan saƙo a wannan na'ura ba.
mobile.chat_unopened_seal_mismatch: Hatimin wannan saƙo bai dace ba, don haka ba a buɗe shi ba.
mobile.chat_unopened_malformed_row: Ba a iya karanta wannan saƙo ba: layin ya lalace.
mobile.chat_unopened_not_text: Wannan saƙo ba rubutu ba ne, kuma wannan ɗaki rubutu kaɗai yake ɗauka.
mobile.chat_unopened_substrate: Ba a iya buɗe wannan saƙo a yanzu ba. Sabunta don sake gwadawa.
mobile.chat_unopened_other: Ba a iya buɗe wannan saƙo ba.
mobile.contacts_add_hint: Manna cikakken ID na tarayya (key_id) na mutumin da kake son tuntuɓa.
mobile.contacts_chat_not_covered: Saƙonni ba za su iya isa ga wannan lambar sadarwa ba tukuna — izinin yarda bai haɗa da hira ba. Ƙara su sake domin faɗaɗa shi.
mobile.contacts_empty_body: Abokin hulɗa shine wanda ka amince ku yi musayar saƙonni da shi. Ƙara shi ta ID na tarayyarsa don fara tattaunawa.
mobile.contacts_no_match: Babu abokin hulɗa da ya dace da “{query}”
