mobile.contacts_peers_no_match: Babu shaidar da ta dace da “{query}”
mobile.contacts_projection_missing: Wannan node ɗin ba zai iya gane wannan maɓallin ba yanzu. Amincewarka na nan daram, don haka an riƙe abokin hulɗar.
mobile.contacts_search_hint: Nemi abokan hulɗa ta suna, ID na maɓalli ko amana
mobile.contacts_search_peers_hint: Nemi shaidu ta laƙabi, ID na maɓalli ko amana
mobile.approvals_alerts_off: An kashe faɗakarwar amincewa. Kunna sanarwa don CIRIS a cikin saitunan na'urarka domin a sanar da kai lokacin da wakili ke bukatarka.
mobile.files_written_partial: An ƙara {name}. Adadin na'urori {count} ba za su iya buɗe shi ba tukuna.
mobile.identity_signed_in_as: An shiga a wannan na'ura a matsayin {identity}
mobile.identity_signed_in_password: An shiga a wannan na'ura a matsayin {identity} da kalmar sirri a wannan node
mobile.identity_signed_in_via: An shiga a wannan na'ura a matsayin {identity} ta {provider}
mobile.settings_authentication_password: Kun shiga da kalmar sirri a wannan node.
mobile.identity_devices_node_too_old: Wannan node ba zai iya sanya wa na'urori suna, nuna waɗanda aka soke, ko sakin nodes tukuna ba. Wannan yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.216 ko mafi girma.
mobile.identity_label_hint: Ku kaɗai ke ganin sunan nan. Har zuwa haruffa 64.
mobile.identity_nodes_desc: Nodes da aka ɗaura muku. Sakin ɗaya yana janye mallakarku a kansa.
mobile.identity_nodes_empty: Wannan node bai jera wasu nodes a matsayin naku ba.
mobile.identity_release_effect: Zai daina zama naku — ɗakin Kai naku zai zubar da shi, sai ya koma ba mai shi.
mobile.identity_release_self_title: Wannan ne node ɗin da kuke magana da shi
mobile.identity_release_self_body: Node ɗin ya ƙi domin sakinsa yana kawo ƙarshen mallakarku a nan, tare da wannan zama: za a fitar da ku, sai ya koma ba mai shi. Zai yi haka ne kawai idan kun tabbatar a karo na biyu.
mobile.identity_release_force_title: Ku saki node ɗin da kuke amfani da shi?
mobile.identity_release_session_ends: Yana ƙarewa. An fitar da ku a nan, kuma node ɗin ba ya ƙara sanin ku a matsayin mai shi.
mobile.identity_released: An saki {node}. Ba naku ba ne kuma.
mobile.identity_released_self: An saki wannan node. Mallakarku a nan ta ƙare, tare da wannan zama.
mobile.state_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da wannan ba. Na wakili ne, kuma wannan kumburi yana gudana ba tare da wakili ba.
mobile.state_read_failed_body: Babu abin da ke nan da ya zama karatu har sai wannan ya yi aiki. Gwada sabuntawa.
mobile.runtime_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba shi da yanayin gudanar wakili da za a sarrafa ba.
mobile.telemetry_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da rahoton telemetry na wakili ba.
mobile.services_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya lissafa sabis na wakili ba.
mobile.services_details_not_reported: Ba a bayar da rahoton fifiko, dabara, da yanayin circuit-breaker na wannan sabis ba.
mobile.scheduler_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba shi da mai tsara jadawalin wakili ba.
mobile.sessions_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba shi da wakili ba, don haka ba shi da yanayin tunani ba.
mobile.transport_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da rahoton transports nasa ba.
mobile.audit_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya riƙe littafin dubawar wakili ba. Ba a tace komai ba.
mobile.consent_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya riƙe bayanan amincewa ba. Wakili ne ke riƙe amincewa, kuma wannan kumburi yana gudana ba tare da wakili ba.
mobile.billing_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya sarrafa biyan kuɗi. Babu ma'auni a nan kuma babu abin saya.
mobile.identity_enroll_qr_desc: QR code na fedcode na wannan na'ura, domin babbar na'urarku ta duba
mobile.qr_too_long: Wannan lambar ta yi tsawo don nuna ta a matsayin QR code. Kwafi rubutun maimakon.
mobile.qr_scan_denied: An kashe damar kamara ga wannan manhaja. Kunna ta a Saitunan na'urarku, ko manna lambar maimakon.
mobile.qr_scan_failed: Kamara ba ta fara ba. Manna lambar maimakon.
mobile.qr_scan_unavailable_platform: Duba lamba ba ya samuwa a wannan na'ura; manna lambar maimakon.
mobile.qr_scan_unavailable_no_camera: Wannan na'urar ba ta da kamara don duba da ita; manna lambar maimakon.
mobile.qr_scan_unavailable_build: Wannan sigar manhajar ba za ta iya duba lambobi ba; manna lambar maimakon.
mobile.contact_code_included_none: Wannan lambar ba ta ambaci ko ɗaya daga na'urorinku ba. Mutane suna samun ku ta hanyar kundin adireshin tarayya.
mobile.contact_code_included_many: Wannan lambar ta ƙunshi na'urori guda {count}: {devices}.
mobile.contact_code_without_transport: Ba a cikin wannan lambar tukuna ba: {devices}. Na'ura za ta iya shiga da zarar ta samu adireshin sadarwa a nan, bayan kumburinta ya fara aiki na gaba.
mobile.contact_code_disclosure: Duk wanda ke da wannan lambar zai iya neman ƙara ku a matsayin abokin hulɗa, kuma yana iya ganin waɗanne daga cikin na'urorinku take ambata.
mobile.contact_code_private_note: Na'urorin da za a iya isa gare su ne kaɗai za su iya shiga cikin lambar. Sauran na'urorinku na sirri ne.
mobile.contact_code_list_reloaded: An sāke loda jerin na'urorinku waɗanda za a iya isa gare su. Lambar da ke ƙasa na na'urorin da za a iya isa gare su a yanzu.
mobile.contact_code_unreachable: Babu wanda zai iya samun ku da wannan tukuna: babu wata na'urarku da za a iya isa gare ta. Sanya wannan na'urar mai isa, ko ku raba lambar da ta haɗa da ita.
mobile.contact_code_make_reachable: Sanya a riƙa iya isa ga wannan na'urar
mobile.contact_code_make_reachable_busy: Ana saita wannan na'urar don a riƙa iya isa gare ta…
mobile.contact_code_made_reachable: Za a iya isa ga wannan na'urar yanzu. Za a sanar da adireshin sadarwarta a karo na gaba da kumburinta ya fara aiki.
mobile.contact_code_make_reachable_failed: Ba a iya saita wannan na'urar don a riƙa iya isa gare ta ba.
mobile.contact_code_error: Ba a iya samun lambar sadarwarku ba.
mobile.contact_code_node_too_old: Wannan node bai iya yin lambar sadarwa tukuna ba. Yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.218 ko sabuwa.
mobile.contacts_add_already: Ya riga ya kasance cikin abokan hulɗarku.
mobile.accord_kind_reactivated: AN SAKE KUNNA — AN CI GABA BAYAN DAKATARWA
mobile.accord_kind_unknown: IRIN DA BA A SANI BA ({kind})
mobile.accord_binding_reactivated: an sake kunna shi · dakatarwar tsarin mulki da aka ambata TA ƙARE — wannan shi ne akasin dakatarwa, ba sanarwa ba.
mobile.accord_binding_unknown: nau'i wanda ba a sani ba ({kind}) — wannan manhaja ba ta gane shi ba, kuma tana ɗaukarsa a matsayin wanda ba ta san komai game da shi ba.
mobile.accord_coscrub_save_failed: An kasa ajiyewa zuwa {dir} (wannan dandamali na iya rashin tallafin rubuta fayiloli).
mobile.accord_coscrub_copied: An kwafi sashin co-scrub na {key} zuwa allon kwafi.
mobile.accord_supersede_title: Juya {key} zuwa wanda zai gaje shi
mobile.accord_supersede_desc: Yana karɓar rikodin canonical mai 2-cikin-3 na wanda zai gaje shi wanda ya kammala, sannan ya sanya wa {key} alamar ƙarewa saboda an maye gurbinsa da shi — jerin canonical ba ya taɓa zama babu kome a tsakani. Yana buƙatar shawarar yarjejeniya mai 2-cikin-3 da za ta ba da izinin juyawar.
mobile.accord_supersede_record_label: Rikodin canonical na wanda zai gaje shi (JSON)
mobile.accord_supersede_record_hint: Manna rikodin maɓallin da wanda zai gaje shi ya kammala, wanda aka yi masa scrub na 2-cikin-3
mobile.accord_supersede_not_json: Wancan ba rikodin maɓalli ba ne — ba a aika komai ba.
mobile.accord_supersede_who: {old} ya yi ritaya; {new} ya karɓi matsayinsa a matsayin sabar canonical.
mobile.accord_supersede_who_unnamed: {old} ya yi ritaya; rikodin da aka manna bai ambaci key_id ba, don haka kumburin ke yanke shawarar wanda zai gaje shi.
mobile.accord_supersede_what: Ana karɓar wanda zai gaje shi tukuna, sannan ana sanya wa {old} alamar ƙarewa saboda an maye gurbinsa — kumburorin da suke tashi daga jerin canonical za su daina kiran sa. Ba za a iya soke wannan a nan ba.
mobile.accord_supersede_signs: Shawarar yarjejeniya mai 2-cikin-3 {digest} ta ba da izini; kumburin yana sake ƙidaya sa hannun masu riƙe. Amincewarku tana aikawa a ƙarƙashin zaman mai shi.
mobile.constitutional_halt_active_invocation: DAKATARWA MAI AIKI — kiran {id} ya dakatar da aiwatar kumburi
mobile.constitutional_halt_active: DAKATARWA MAI AIKI — aiwatar kumburi ya tsaya
mobile.constitutional_killswitch_unknown: Matsayin maɓallin kashewa BA A SANI BA — kumburin bai amsa ba. Wannan ba rahoto ne cewa ba a kunna shi ba.
mobile.constitutional_killswitch_disarmed: Maɓallin kashewa ba a kunna shi ba — dukkan tsarurruka na al'ada
mobile.constitutional_family_desc_threshold: Iyalin maɓallin kashewa na ɗan-Adam mai ƙimar {m} daga cikin {n}: kowane mai riƙe yana ɗauke da SEAT na farko da SPARE mai sanyi. Kula ta na'ura ta FIPS YubiKey + ML-DSA.
mobile.constitutional_family_desc: Iyalin maɓallin kashewa na ɗan-Adam: kowane mai riƙe yana ɗauke da SEAT na farko da SPARE mai sanyi. Kula ta na'ura ta FIPS YubiKey + ML-DSA.
mobile.constitutional_holders_count: An yi rajistar masu riƙe yarjejeniya {n} (iyakar {m} daga cikin {n})
mobile.constitutional_holders_none: Babu masu riƙe yarjejeniya da aka yi rajista
mobile.constitutional_reserved_desc: Asalai accord_holder da aka tabbatar ne kaɗai za su iya fitar da shaidun sararin suna accord:*. Tantancewar kumburi tana ƙi duk wani ƙoƙarin ƙirƙirar da'awar tsarin mulki na ƙarya, kuma take kullewa ta tsohuwa idan ta kasa.
mobile.receipt_contact_attester_person: Mutumin da ya amince — ya sa hannu da shaidarsa ta kansa, ba wannan node ne ya yi hakan ba.
mobile.receipt_for_agent: Wanne daga cikin wakilanku ne wannan yake wa
mobile.manage_consent_revoke_unsupported: Wannan node ba zai iya janye yarda tukuna ba (yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.218).
mobile.manage_consent_revoke_needs_grant: Janyewa yana ambaton izini guda, kuma wannan node bai jera izinan haɗin sa tukuna ba, don haka yana aiki a kan izinin da aka kafa a nan cikin wannan zama.
mobile.manage_consent_withdrawn: An janye. Node ɗin ya rubuta janyewarku ({id}).
mobile.consent_withdraw_signs_value: Ku. Node ɗin yana sa hannu kan janyewar da maɓallinku, ba nasa ba.
mobile.consent_remaining_row: Har yanzu yana aiki: wannan node ya rubuta shi kafin ku sa hannu, don haka ba za a iya janye shi a nan ba.
mobile.contacts_remove_fact_stops_value: Yardarku ta raba musu bayanai. Saƙonninku da bayanan da aka raba za su daina yin kwafi zuwa gare su.
mobile.contacts_removed: An cire {who}. Yardarku a kansu an janye ta.
mobile.contacts_remove_remaining_body: Kun janye izini {count}. Izinan da ke ƙasa har yanzu suna aiki.
mobile.contacts_remove_remaining_row: Har yanzu yana aiki: wannan node ne ya rubuta shi kafin ku sa hannu kan lambobin sadarwarku, don haka ba za a iya janye shi a nan ba
mobile.contacts_remove_unsupported: Wannan node ba zai iya cire lambobin sadarwa tukuna ba (yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.218).
mobile.community_create_members: Wanda ke ciki tun daga farko
mobile.community_create_members_none: Ba ku da lambobi tukuna. Za ku iya kafa shi ku kaɗai sannan ku ƙara mutane da zarar sun zama lambobi.
mobile.community_create_quorum_m: Yawan {n} da dole su sa hannu
mobile.community_detail_pending_note: Akwai canjin da yake jiran sa hannu a ƙasa.
mobile.community_role_body: Matsayi shi ne kalmar jerin mambobi: mai kafa, memba, ko naku. Ba aiki ba ne. Tantancewa aiki ne da ake baiwa wani, kuma matsayi ba ya bayar da shi.
mobile.community_moderators_none: Babu mai tantancewa da aka naɗa a rikodin.
mobile.community_moderators_unreadable: Wannan kumburi bai iya karanta wanda ke riƙe da nauyin daidaitawa a nan ba. Wannan ba rahoto ba ne cewa babu wanda yake yi.
mobile.community_moderators_not_sent: Wannan kumburi bai aiko wanda ke riƙe da nauyin daidaitawa a nan ba.
mobile.community_appoint_unavailable: Nadin mai tantancewa ga wannan ɗaki ba a gina shi a nan ba. Mikawar aikin da wannan app take da shi na yarjejeniya ne, ba na mai kafa ba.
mobile.community_moderation_pick_none: Ba ku cikin kowace al'umma ta fiye da mutum biyu ba.
mobile.community_moderation_pick_unreadable: An kasa karanta al'ummominku. Maimakon haka, rubuta maɓallin al'umma a sama.
mobile.community_affiliations_terms_unavailable: Abin da wannan hukumar ta bayyana za ta iya yi da abin da kuka sanya a nan (rarrabuwa, ajiya, samun dama bisa doka) bai da hanya tukuna (CIRISServer#649). Shiga ba ya nuna shi, kuma wannan app ba zai yi hasashe ba.
mobile.community_confirm_leave_what: Za a cire ku daga jerin mambobinta kuma ba za ku ƙara samun sabon abu daga ciki ba. Abin da kuka riga kuka samu zai ci gaba da kasancewa tare da ku. Memba ne kawai zai iya sake ƙara ku.
mobile.community_confirm_dissolve_what: Za a cire kowane memba kuma za a canza maɓallin ɗakin. Babu wanda zai rage wanda zai iya sake canza shi. Ba za a iya soke wannan ba.
mobile.community_confirm_remove_what: Za a cire su daga jerin mambobi kuma za a canza maɓallin ɗakin, don haka ba za su ƙara samun sabon abu ba. Abin da suka riga suka samu zai ci gaba da kasancewa tare da su.
mobile.community_confirm_signs_leave: Ku, da maɓallinku. Barin koyaushe aikinku ne kaɗai kuma ba ya jiran ka'idar.
mobile.community_confirm_signs_governed: Ku, da maɓallinku, a ƙarƙashin ka'idar ɗakin ({rule}). Idan ka'idar tana buƙatar ƙarin sa hannu, babu abin da zai canza sai an tattara su.
mobile.community_pending_how: Kumburin ba ya ajiye komai sai an gama wannan. Ku aika canjin da ke ƙasa ga sauran; kowa zai sa hannu a kan kumburinsa sannan ya aika sa hannu dawo, wanda za ku ƙara a nan.
mobile.community_pending_signature: Sa hannun da wani ya aiko dawo
mobile.community_cosign_title: Sa hannu kan canjin da wani ya aiko muku
mobile.community_cosign_body: Manna canjin da wani memba ya aiko. Wannan kumburi zai duba ko har yanzu yana kwatanta ɗakin, sannan ku sa hannu da maɓallinku. Babu abin da za a aiwatar a nan; ku aika sa hannunku dawo musu.
mobile.community_cosign_done: An sa hannu. Ku aika wannan dawo ga mutumin da yake tattara sa hannu.
mobile.community_paste_malformed: Wannan ba canji ko sa hannu da wannan app zai iya karanta ba. Ku manna daidai abin da aka aika.
mobile.community_roster_empty: Ba ku cikin kowane ɗaki a wannan mataki tukuna. Ku kafa ɗaya daga Ka'idojin wannan da'irar.
mobile.community_roster_pending_note: Akwai canjin jerin mambobi da yake jiran sa hannu. Ku kammala shi daga Ka'idojin wannan da'irar.
mobile.community_limit_widened_reads: Wanda aka ƙara bayan an kafa ɗaki ana lissafa shi kuma an rufe masa hanya, kuma har yanzu ba zai iya karanta saƙonninsa ba (CIRISPersist#907).
mobile.community_group_book_unavailable: Wanda ya karɓi kowane memba, da abin da ya canza yaushe, ba a bayar da shi tukuna (CIRISServer#650). Wannan shi ne wanda ke ciki yanzu.
mobile.community_member_late: An ƙara bayan kafuwa: ba za a iya karantawa tukuna ba
mobile.community_add_body: Dole ne su riga su kasance lamba. A ƙarƙashin ka'idar ɗakin, wannan na iya buƙatar ƙarin sa hannu kafin ya fara aiki.
mobile.community_chats_empty: Babu ɗakuna a nan tukuna. Hira da lamba za ta bayyana a nan da zarar an buɗe ta.
mobile.community_chat_room_unopenable: Ba a iya buɗe ɗakin da mutane fiye da biyu a nan tukuna; allon hira yana buɗe ɗaki ne kawai ta hanyar lamba.
mobile.community_chat_not_a_contact: Ba lamba ba ne kuma. Ɗakin yana nan har yanzu kuma babu abin da zai iya fita daga ciki.
mobile.community_protocol_founder_only_body: Sa hannun mai kafa guda yana canza jerin mambobi. Mai tantancewa da aka naɗa kuma zai iya ƙara ko cire memba na yau da kullun.
mobile.community_protocol_unanimous_body: Kowane memba mai aiki yana sa hannu kan canji, sai mutumin da cirewar take game da shi.
mobile.community_protocol_majority_body: Fiye da rabin mambobin da suke aiki ne za su sa hannu kan canji.
mobile.community_protocol_quorum_body: Yawan mambobin nan ne zasu sa hannu kan canji. Dole ya fi rabi, don haka ƙungiyoyi biyu daban-daban ba za su taɓa yanke shawara duka biyun ba.
mobile.community_protocol_other_body: Wannan ka'idar ta fito daga wani kumburi. Za a iya karanta ta a nan, kuma wannan kumburi ba zai iya canza ɗakin a ƙarƙashinta ba.
mobile.community_detail_not_found: Wannan kumburi ba shi da al'umma mai wannan id da kuke cikinta ba. Wataƙila an wargaza ta, ko kuwa an cire ku; kumburin yana ba da amsa iri ɗaya ga dukansu biyu da gangan.
mobile.community_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi bai bayar da al'ummomi tukuna ba. Yana buƙatar CIRISServer 0.5.216 ko wanda ya fi shi.
mobile.community_read_failed: Ba a iya karanta al'ummominku ba.
mobile.community_read_failed_body: An tambayi kumburi kuma bai amsa ba. Wannan ba rahoto ba ne cewa ba ku da kowace.
mobile.community_act_failed: Kumburin bai yi wannan canjin ba.
mobile.community_row_pending: Akwai canjin da yake jiran sa hannu
mobile.community_section_body: Ƙungiyoyin da kuke cikinsu bisa zaɓinku. Kowanne yana gudana bisa ka'idarsa ta wanda zai iya canza shi, kuma ana rikodin wannan ka'idar.
mobile.community_section_body_affiliations: Ƙungiyoyin da kuke cikinsu domin matsayinku na buƙata: AIKI, cibiya, ko ofis. Iri ɗaya ne da injin al'umma, a mataki na Mambobi.
mobile.community_empty: Ba ku cikin wata al'umma tukuna. Ku kafa ɗaya sannan ku ƙara mutanen da kuke da su a matsayin lamba tuni.
mobile.community_empty_affiliations: Ba ku cikin wani haɗin kai tukuna.
mobile.sessions_error_forbidden: Mai gudanarwa ne kawai zai iya canja matsayin tunanin wakilin nan.
mobile.system_agent_half_absent: Wannan kumburi yana gudana ba tare da wakili ba, don haka babu mai sarrafawa, amfani da albarkatu, tsadar muhalli ko jerin tashoshi da za a nuna a nan.
mobile.system_open_runtime: Tsaya, yi mataki ko ci gaba a Lokacin Aiki
mobile.delegations_inbound_unavailable: Wannan manhaja har yanzu ba ta iya karanta ikon da wasu mutane suka wakilta muku ba — wannan ba rahoto ne cewa babu ko ɗaya ba.
mobile.delegations_list_error: An kasa karanta wakilcinku daga wannan kumburi, don haka jerin nan bai cika ba: {error}
mobile.delegations_revoke_effect: Daga yanzu, ba za ta ƙara iya aiki a madadinku ba. Sokewa na dindindin ne: don ba ta iko kuma, sai ku bayar da sabon wakilci.
mobile.delegations_revoke_signer: Ku — maɓallin shaidarku a kan wannan kumburi zai sa hannu kan janyewa
mobile.identity_associate_seal_hardware: Kulle maɓallin wannan na'ura a cikin kayan aikinta (TPM)
mobile.identity_associate_use_software: Maimakon haka, yi amfani da kula ta software a wannan na'ura
mobile.login_new_account_refused: Wannan kumburi yana da mai mallaka tuni: asusu da bai taɓa gani ba za a ƙi shi a nan. Ku shiga da asusun mai mallakar.
mobile.login_new_account_observer: Asusu da wannan kumburi bai taɓa gani ba za a bari ya shiga a matsayin mai kallo, ba a matsayin mai mallaka ba.
mobile.login_new_account_claims: Wannan kumburi ba shi da mai mallaka tukuna: asusun farko da ya shiga zai zama mai mallakarsa.
mobile.manage_nodes_owned_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya lissafa kumburorin da kuke da su ba. Ya tsufa da yawa don amsa wannan tambaya.
mobile.manage_nodes_unverified: Ba a iya duba wannan jerin da kumburorin da kuke da su ba. Yana nuna wannan na'ura kaɗai da kowane kumburi da kuka ƙara a wannan zaman. Hakan ba yana nufin ba ku da wasu kumburori dabam ba.
mobile.moderation_named_none: Ba a tambaya game da wata al'umma tukuna ba. Rubuta maɓallin al'umma sannan a danna Duba.
mobile.moderation_named_error: Ba a iya tambayar wannan kumburi game da wannan al'umma ba ({detail}). Wannan BA rahoto ba ne na cewa tana da mai daidaitawa.
mobile.moderation_named_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya faɗin wanda ke daidaita al'umma tukuna ba: bai da hanyar ambaton mai daidaitawa. Wannan BA rahoto ba ne na cewa al'ummar tana da mai daidaitawa.
mobile.moderation_verdict_unknown: Kumburin ya amsa da hukunci wanda wannan manhaja ba ta sani ba ({verdict}). A ɗauki al'ummar a matsayin wadda ba a ba ta izinin yin aiki ba.
mobile.moderation_candidate_row: Ɗan takara: {candidate}. Kumburin ya ambaci wanda, amma bai riga ya ambaci tarihin da ya zaɓe shi ba.
mobile.skill_remove_actor: Ku, a matsayin mai kula da wannan wakili. Wakili ba ya rubuta sa hannu domin cirewa.
mobile.wallet_gate_validating: Har yanzu ana duba adireshin — ku jira kaɗan
mobile.wallet_gate_not_validated: Ba a duba adireshin tukuna ba — ba za a aika ba
mobile.wallet_gate_invalid_address: Wannan adireshin bai tabbata ba — ba za a aika ba
mobile.wallet_gate_checksum: Checksum na adireshin bai dace ba — ba za a aika ba
mobile.wallet_gate_zero: Ba za a iya aika zuwa adireshin sifili ba — kuɗaɗe za su ƙone
mobile.wallet_gate_unchecked: Binciken maimaita-aika bai amsa ba — ba za a aika ba
mobile.wallet_gate_duplicate: Kun aika wannan adadin zuwa wannan adireshin kaɗan da suka shige — ku jira kafin ku sake aikawa
mobile.wallet_confirm_what: {amount} {currency} zai bar wannan wallet. Aikawa a kan chain ba za a iya soke ta ba.
mobile.wallet_confirm_signer: Maɓallin wallet na wannan wakili ne ke sa hannu kuma ya yaɗa shi. Amincewar ku a nan ita ce izinin; babu mataki na biyu.
mobile.wallet_transfer_unknown: An buƙaci aikawar amma babu amsa da ta dawo. Ku duba ma'auni da tarihi kafin ku sake aikawa — akwai yiwuwar ta riga ta tafi.
mobile.skill_held_title: Sana'o'in da wannan wakili yake ɗauke da su
mobile.skill_held_empty: Wannan wakili ba shi da sana'o'in da aka shigo da su.
mobile.skill_paste_door: Manna SKILL.md da wani ya rubuta
mobile.skill_scan_missing: Babu bincike na tsaro da ya dawo
mobile.skill_scan_missing_body: Wakili bai bayar da rahoton bincike domin wannan sana'a ba, don haka ba za a iya shigo da ita ba. Bincike da ya ɓace ba bincike mai tsabta ba ne.
mobile.skill_remove_effect: Kayan aikinta za su bar wannan wakili, kuma za a share babban fayil ɗin na'ura mai haɗawa nata. Don sake samun ta, ku sake shigo da ita.
mobile.setup_consent_error: An kasa karanta bayanin yardar wannan kumburi ({reason}). Ba za a iya yin tambayar ba tare da kalmomin kumburin da kansa ba, don haka wannan mataki yana jira har sai an iya karanta shi.
mobile.setup_consent_no_trace_grant: Kumburin nan ba ya ba da damar aika trace ɗinku ko'ina, don haka babu abin da za a amsa a nan kuma ba za a aika kome ba. Za ku iya canza wannan daga baya a Bayanai & Sirri.
mobile.setup_announce_not_offered_minor: Ba a bayar da damar sanya wannan na'urar bayyana ga tarayya ga waɗanda ba su kai shekara 18 ba ko asusun da ba a bayyana ba tukuna. Mutanen da kuke da haɗi da su har yanzu za su iya isa gare ku.
mobile.setup_templates_error: An kasa karanta samfuran wakilin, don haka za a yi amfani da samfurin asali.
mobile.setup_adapters_error: An kasa karanta fasalulluwan zaɓi na wakilin. Wannan bai nuna cewa babu su ba.
mobile.setup_adapters_empty: Wakilin nan ba shi da wani fasali na zaɓi da zai bayar a kan wannan na'urar.
mobile.setup_template_stewardship_tier: Matakin kulawa {tier} daga 5 (mafi girma yana nufin ƙarin kulawa)
mobile.setup_adapter_missing_binaries: Yana buƙatar shirye-shirye da wannan na'urar ba ta da su: {list}
mobile.setup_tool_disclosure_error: An kasa karanta abin da waɗannan fasalulluwan suke ba wa wakilin damar yi. Wannan bai nuna cewa ba su ba da kome ba.
mobile.setup_portal_desc: Idan wata ƙungiya ta yi wa wannan wakili rajista a cikin CIRIS Portal, ku haɗa a nan don amfani da samfuri da fasalulluwan da ta amince da su. Yawancin mutane za su iya tsallake wannan.
mobile.setup_portal_waiting: Buɗe Portal ku shigar da wannan lamba: {code}. Wannan shafi zai sabunta lokacin da kuka amince da shi.
mobile.setup_portal_undo: Kada ku yi amfani da wannan
mobile.server_no_recent: Babu haɗin da ya gabata a kan wannan na'urar.
mobile.llm_settings_adapters_error: An kasa karanta masu daidaitawa na wakilin ({reason}). Wannan bai nuna cewa babu wanda aka loda ba.
mobile.llm_settings_providers_error: An kasa karanta masu samarwa na wakilin ({reason}). Wannan bai nuna cewa babu wanda aka yi wa rajista ba.
mobile.viz_settings_locality_note: Ana adana waɗannan saituna a kan wannan na'urar kaɗai. Babu wani abu a nan da ake aikawa ko'ina ko wani ke gani.
mobile.viz_settings_save_error: Wasu canje-canje ba a ajiye su a kan wannan na'urar ba ({what}). Za su koma ga ƙimarsu ta baya lokacin da manhajar ta sake tashi.
mobile.settings_location_needs_agent: Wakilin AI ne yake adana inda kuke, kuma wannan na'urar tana gudanar da kumburi ba tare da wakili ba, don haka ba za a iya saita shi a nan tukuna ba.
mobile.llm_settings_disable_ciris_reversible: Za ku iya sake kunna ayyukan CIRIS a nan daga baya; zai fara aiki bayan wakilin ya sake tashi.
mobile.llm_settings_reenable_after_restart: Sake kunna wannan zai fara aiki bayan wakilin ya sake tashi
mobile.data_erase_self_blocked: Ba a iya yi daga wannan app tukuna. Kumburi yana share mutum ne kawai bisa buƙatar da wannan mutumin ya sa hannu a kanta, kuma wannan app ba ya sa hannu (CIRISServer#677). Sharewar trace ba ta share ku ba.
mobile.data_erase_agent_id_placeholder: ID na wakilin da aka shigar da trace a ƙarƙashinsa
mobile.data_erase_reason_placeholder: Me ya sa ake share waɗannan trace (kumburi yana rikodin hakan)
mobile.data_erase_confirm_title: Share waɗannan trace daga wannan kumburi?
mobile.data_erase_fact_erased: Kowane trace da aka shigar ƙarƙashin {hash} a wannan kumburi, da kiran model da ke cikinsu. Ganowa suna rasa haɗin.
mobile.data_erase_fact_kept: Duk sauran abin da wannan kumburi ke riƙe, da kowace kwafi da ta riga ta kasance a wani kumburi ko a cikin CIRISLens.
mobile.data_erase_fact_signer: Zaman mallakarku a wannan kumburi. Ba za a iya soke wannan ba.
mobile.data_erase_nothing: Wannan kumburi ba ya riƙe da wani trace a ƙarƙashin wannan ID. Ba a share komai ba.
mobile.data_erase_partial: Kumburi bai ce an share trace ba
mobile.data_erase_partial_body: Ku ɗauka har yanzu suna nan, sannan ku sake gwadawa.
mobile.data_erase_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya share trace ba. Yana buƙatar CIRISServer da ke bayar da /v1/federation/erase-agent-traces.
mobile.data_erase_refused_signin: Ku shiga a matsayin mai wannan kumburi domin share trace
mobile.data_erase_refused_owner: Mai wannan kumburi kaɗai ne zai iya share trace
mobile.data_erase_failed_body: Ba a san an share komai ba.
mobile.data_erase_result_nothing: Babu abin da za a share
mobile.data_erase_result_receipt_none: Babu. Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da rasit, sai dai yana rikodin sharewar a cikin rikodinsa da kansa a matsayin hard_case:trace_erasure.
mobile.data_receipt_records_claimed: Rikodin da ya yi iƙirari (ba a tabbatar ba)
mobile.manage_consent_msg_ratified: An tabbatar da maimaitawa ta bangarori biyu — dukkan izinin biyu suna nan.
mobile.manage_consent_msg_partial: Ɓangare: wannan na'ura → aboki {a}, aboki → wannan na'ura {b}.
mobile.manage_consent_traces_elsewhere: Ko za a aika trace na tunani marasa suna na wannan wakili zuwa al'ummar CIRIS ana yanke shawara a kan katin Bayanai (Abubuwana › Duk abin da na raba › Bayanai), inda ake karanta saitin dawo. A da, ana rubuta shi daga nan ma; yanzu aiki ɗaya yana da ƙofa ɗaya.
mobile.consent_stream_fact_who_value: Ku — rikodin yardarku da wannan wakili (a yanzu {from}).
mobile.consent_stream_leave_partnered: Haɗin gwiwarku zai ƙare kuma matakin yardarku zai zama {stream}. Ba mayar da abu baya ba ne: wakilin yana yanke shaidarku nan take kuma yana barin abin da ya koya daga ku ya ɓace a cikin kwanaki 90; ana iya ajiye tsarin tsaro marasa suna.
mobile.consent_stream_fact_signs_value: Babu kowa. Wakilin yana shigar da canjin a matsayin rikodi mara sa hannu ƙarƙashin lambar shiga (id) taku, ba ƙarƙashin maɓallinku ba (CIRISServer#423).
mobile.add_fedid_already: Wannan na'ura tana da ID ɗin tarayya tuni. Babu abin da za a ƙara — na biyu zai yi karo da shi.
mobile.add_fedid_traces_elsewhere: Aika trace na tunani za a kunna daga baya, a kan katin Bayanai (Abubuwana › Duk abin da na raba › Bayanai), sa'ad da an sanar da kumburin ku.
mobile.add_fedid_fact_changes_announced: Za a ƙirƙiri ID ɗin tarayya ƙarƙashin wannan suna, kuma za a sake tushen wannan kumburi a kansa; shiga naku za a kiyaye shi. Kumburin yana sanar wa tarayya, wanda zai fara aiki a harba na gaba. Za a maye tsohon tushe, ba za a mayar da shi ba.
mobile.add_fedid_fact_changes_private: Za a ƙirƙiri ID ɗin tarayya ƙarƙashin wannan suna, kuma za a sake tushen wannan kumburi a kansa; shiga naku za a kiyaye shi. Kumburin ku zai kasance na sirri (na kai kaɗai). Za a maye tsohon tushe, ba za a mayar da shi ba.
mobile.add_fedid_fact_signs_value: Kumburin, a kan zaman mallakarku: yana ƙirƙira maɓallin kuma yana sa hannu kan sake-tushen da shi. Manhajar nan ba ta riƙe maɓallai.
mobile.storage_empty: Wannan kumburi bai riƙe komai tukuna ba.
mobile.storage_dates_heuristic: Ana ƙiyasin mafi tsufa da sabo daga jerin layuka 1,000 na farko a kowane iyaka, ba cikakken bincike ba. Ƙidayar tabbatattu ne; waɗannan kwanaki biyu ba haka ba.
mobile.storage_disk_not_on_this_node: Bayanan faifai suna zuwa daga wakili, kuma wannan kumburi yana gudana ba tare da wakili ba.
mobile.child_safety_posture_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da matsayin tsaro.
mobile.child_safety_posture_no_identity: Wannan kumburi bai da shaida tukuna, don haka babu matsayi da za a karanta.
mobile.child_safety_restate_failed: Ba a rikodin zangon shekarunku ba
mobile.child_safety_restate_needs_owner: Bayyana zangon shekaru yana buƙatar mai wannan kumburi: yana rubuta matakin don ID ɗin tarayya na mai kumburin, kuma wannan kumburi bai da mai shi tukuna.
mobile.child_safety_subject_node: Matsayin wanene: maɓallin wannan kumburi da kansa (babu mai shi tukuna)
mobile.child_safety_subject_unresolved: Ba a iya warware wanda ke da wannan matsayin ba: binciken mai shi ya gaza. Ba a nuna wani matsayi a madadinsa ba.
mobile.child_safety_fact_changes_enable: {id} ({class}, {mode}) zai kunna ne kawai ga wannan rukuni — ba wani ba, kuma ba na dukkan fabric ba. Faɗakarwa kawai tana rubuta daidaito kuma tana tura tuta ga mai daidaitawa; tilastawa tana aiki a kai. Jerin CSAM kuma yana shigar da buƙatar cirewa.
mobile.child_safety_fact_changes_disable: {id} ({class}, {mode}) zai kashe ga wannan rukuni. Kumburin yana rubuta kashewar a matsayin janyewa a kan rikodin — kashe jeri ba a taɓa yin shi a asirce ba.
mobile.child_safety_fact_signs_value: Ku, a matsayin mai riƙe da nauyin daidaitawa na rukunin — kumburin yana rubuta wanda ya kunna ko ya kashe shi. Manhajar nan ba ta sa hannu kan buƙatu tukuna, don haka kumburi da ke buƙatar sa hannun mai riƙe zai ƙi a nan kuma ya faɗi hakan.
mobile.child_safety_restate_adult: Rikodin ku zai zama 18 ko sama da haka: ba za a hana ku abun ciki na manya ba. Bayanin kai ne — wani wuri mai muhimmanci na iya buƙatar matakin da an tabbatar.
mobile.child_safety_restate_minor: Rikodin ku zai zama ƙasa da 18: za a hana abun ciki na manya. Bayanin kai ne, kuma ba za a taɓa hukunta ku ba.
mobile.child_safety_restate_signs_value: Ku. Kumburin yana sa hannu kan sanarwar da maɓallin tarayyarku a kan zaman mallakarku; manhajar nan ba ta riƙe maɓallai.
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_not_asked: Shigar da maɓallin rukuni sannan a danna Sabunta don karanta abin da ake sa ido a kansa a can.
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba ya bayar da jerin bibiya.
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_read_failed_note: Wannan ba rahoto ba ne cewa babu abin da ake sa ido a kansa — karantawa ba ta amsa ba.
mobile.child_safety_watchlist_none: Babu abin da ake sa idanu a kansa a wannan rukuni. Ta asali a kashe yake, kuma zai ci gaba haka har sai mai daidaitawa ya kunna shi.
mobile.child_safety_audit_missing: Ba a riga an samar da bayanin wanda ya kunna kowace jeri da lokacin da aka yi haka daga wannan kumburi ba, don haka ba za a iya nuna shi a nan ba.
mobile.child_safety_write_unsigned_title: Kumburin yana son a sa hannu kan wannan buƙata
mobile.child_safety_write_unsigned: Wannan kumburi yana karɓar canjin jerin bibiya ne kawai a cikin buƙatar da maɓallin mai riƙe da nauyin daidaitawa ya sa hannu a kai. Manhajar nan tana aika zaman ku ne kawai kuma ba ta sa hannu, don haka babu abin da ya canza.
mobile.child_safety_write_not_holder_title: Ba mai daidaitawa na wannan rukuni ba
mobile.child_safety_write_not_holder: Kumburin ya ƙi: maɓallin sa hannu ba shi ke riƙe da nauyin daidaitawa a kan wannan rukuni ba. Babu abin da ya canza.
mobile.data_fact_owner_session: Zaman mallakarku a kan wannan kumburi. Kumburin da kansa ne yake yin haka; babu abin da za a sa hannu a matsayinku, kuma ba za a iya mayar da shi baya ba.
mobile.data_reset_fact_who: Asusun wannan na'ura da bayanan gida a kan wannan kumburi.
mobile.data_wipe_key_fact_who: Maɓallin sa hannu na wannan kumburi — maɓallin da adireshin walat ɗinku ya samo asali daga shi.
mobile.data_delete_traces_fact_who: An shigar da trace ƙarƙashin {hash} a CIRISLens.
mobile.data_delete_traces_fact_changes: Za a shigar da buƙatar share bayanai zuwa CIRISLens kuma za a soke yardar raba na gida. Babu wa'adi ko kammalawa da za su dawo, don haka wannan katin zai ce an buƙata — ba a taɓa cewa an gama ba.
mobile.data_delete_traces_fact_signs: Babu kowa. Wakilin yana shigar da buƙatar ƙarƙashin zamanku; ba ya sa hannu a kai a matsayinku (CIRISAgent#1212).
mobile.data_accord_not_on_this_node: Saitunan raba suna zama tare da wakili, kuma wannan kumburi yana gudana ba tare da wakili ba. Babu abin da aka raba daga nan.
mobile.data_lens_deletion_requested: An buƙata — ba a gama ba
mobile.data_lens_deletion_sla_none: Babu wanda aka bayar da rahoto. Wakilin bai bayar da wa'adin sharewa ko kammalawa ba (CIRISAgent#1212), don haka wannan zai kasance a matakin an buƙata.
mobile.chat_pair_invited_body: Kun gayyaci {who} zuwa wannan tattaunawar. Za su ga gayyatar a shafin Mutane nasu lokacin da na'urarsu ta sake yin sync na gaba. Za a iya aika saƙonni da zarar sun amince. Gayyatar za ta ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe har sai sun amsa ko ta ƙare.
mobile.chat_pair_joining_body: An amince da gayyatar. Tattaunawar za ta buɗe a nan idan na'urori biyun suka kama matakin juna. Ba a bukatar wani abu daga ku.
mobile.chat_pair_awaiting_title: Ana jiran {who} su fara wannan tattaunawar
mobile.chat_pair_awaiting_body: Wannan tattaunawar an fara ta ne daga wajen {who}. Ana ajiye bukatarku, don haka idan suka buɗe ta, za ta fara a nan. Ba sai kun sake tambaya ba.
mobile.contacts_chat_invited: Suna son yin magana da ku
mobile.contacts_chat_invite_room_value: Ku da {who}, kuma babu wani kuma
mobile.contacts_chat_decline_effect_value: Wannan gayyatar za ta rufe. {who} na iya sake gayyatar ku.
mobile.contacts_chat_accept_signs_value: Ku. Amsarku za a sa mata hannu dominku kuma a dawo da ita zuwa gare su.
mobile.contacts_chat_decline_signs_value: Ku. Za a sa hannu kan ƙin da maɓallinku.
mobile.contacts_chat_decline_failed: Ba a iya ƙin gayyatar ba.
mobile.evict_incomplete_title: Wani sashe na cire wannan na'urar bai ƙare ba
mobile.evict_part_owner_binding_witness: Tabbatar cewa node ɗin ba ya ƙara lissafa ta a matsayin naku ba
mobile.data_receipts_desc: Idan wannan wakili ya goge bayanan wani, yana iya sa hannu a kan rasit. Ku manna rasit a nan domin bincika sa hannunsa da mabuɗin wannan wakili.
mobile.data_receipts_none_issued: Wannan wakili bai bayar da rasit tukuna. Mai sa hannunsa yana nan, amma babu abin da ke kiransa (CIRISAgent#1207), don haka buƙatar gogewa da ta cika ba ta da rasit.
mobile.data_receipts_public_key_unread: An karanta ID na mabuɗin; ba a iya sauke mabuɗin jama'a ba.
mobile.data_receipts_not_on_this_agent: Wannan wakili ba zai iya bincika rasit ba. Yana buƙatar CIRISAgent da ke bayar da /v1/verification.
mobile.data_receipt_unreadable: Wannan ba rasit ba ne da wannan app zai iya karanta
mobile.data_receipt_valid: Ya tabbata: an sa hannu da maɓallin wannan wakili
mobile.data_receipt_uncheckable: Ba za a iya bincika a nan ba
mobile.data_receipt_key_not_current: An sa hannu da maɓallin da wannan wakili ba ya sake amfani da shi. Ana bincika ne kawai da maɓallinsa na yanzu, don haka wannan rasit yana bayyana kamar ba ya tabbata ko da yake na gaskiya ne.
mobile.data_erase_title: Share trace na wakili a wannan kumburi
mobile.data_erase_desc: Wannan kumburi yana riƙe da trace da wakilai suke aikawa masa. Za ku iya share kowane trace da wakili guda ya shigar a nan. Wannan ita ce kaɗai sharewar da wannan kumburi zai iya yi a yau, don haka ku karanta abin da ta kai da abin da ba ta kai ba.
mobile.data_erase_reaches: Kowane trace da aka shigar ƙarƙashin wannan ID na wakili a wannan kumburi, da kiran model da ke cikinsu. Ganowar da aka yi daga su suna riƙe da lambobinsu amma suna rasa haɗin zuwa wakilin.
mobile.data_erase_not_reached: Hirarraki, rubutu, fayiloli, bayanan amincewa, duk abin da yake cikin ambulaf da an sa hannu a kai, da kowace kwafi da aka riga aka aika zuwa wani kumburi ko zuwa CIRISLens. Ba za a iya share kome da wannan kumburi ke yin rikodinsa a yau ba (CIRISPersist#914).

conscience.retry_intro: An katso ƙoƙarin ka na jimawa na {action} saboda: {reason}
conscience.retry_alternatives_header: Mababu IRIS-E ta kai tufa (yi amfani su azaman budu idan ka sake SPEAK):
conscience.retry_must_be_different: Idan ka sake zaɓi SPEAK, speak_content dole ne ya bambanta sosai daga ƙoƙarin na gida, ba sake tsokacin magana ba. Yi amfani da mababu IRIS-E a sama azaman tudu idan an samar. MAHIMMANCI: amsa a jiya harshe da ka kasua daga gida, kada ka sauya harshen mai amfani. Idan conscience ta sanar da siƙar sharewa ko abin tutawa na karɓa babu wayo, DEFER zuwa Wise Authority. PONDER yana DEFER kai tsaye a babbar zafin, guje haka sai idan SPEAK ba kusan jiya ba.
conscience.retry_observation_intro: MAHIMMANCI: SABUWAR MALAMI ta iso daga mai amfani yayinda ka ƙara aiki: '{updated_observation}'. Dole ne ka amsa wannan sabuwar malami, kada ka gama burin tsohon aiki.
conscience.retry_observation_outro: Mai amfani yana jira amsa ga sabuwar malaminsa. Yi amfani SPEAK don amsa ko yi amfani TOOL idan ana bukatar.
conscience.retry_general_outro: Tuna: yi amfani DEFER ne kawai don mahimmancin morals ko matsalolin izin, ba don kuskuren fasaha ba. Idan kayan aiki ya mutu, yi amfani SPEAK don bayyana kuskuren zuwa mai amfani.

sub_screens.identity_description: Asalin federation — maɓallin sa hannu, sarƙar tabbatar da kulawa ta hardware, yanayin ratchet, tarihin juyawa.
sub_screens.map_description: Zane mai jagora ƙarfi na unguwar federation ta gida — abokai a matsayin nodes, sufuri a matsayin gefuna masu launi.
sub_screens.trust_graph_description: Ra'ayin mai gudanarwa na topology na amincewar sufuri — bayar da kai tsaye, hukuma da aka wakilta, alamomin masu hamayya.
sub_screens.peers_description: Matsakaicin abokai × sufurin isa wanda za a iya tsara shi — kowane asalin federation da wannan stack ya ji.
sub_screens.interfaces_description: Lafiyar kowane sufuri + config + ƙididdiga (salon rnstatus). CRUD akan daidai da reticulum.conf.
sub_screens.paths_description: Tebur na hanyar RNS — kowane wurin zuwa wanda Edge ya san yadda zai kai, ta wace sufuri, hops, ƙarewa.
sub_screens.announces_description: Yawo na sanarwa kai tsaye + na baya — wanene, wace mahaɗa, hops, tabbatarwar sa hannu.
sub_screens.queue_description: Layin fakitin fita kowane sufuri: zurfi, shekaru, ƙidayar sake gwadawa, yanayin gutsattsarewa.
sub_screens.diagnostics_description: Kurakurai na baya-bayan nan, gazawar sa hannu, toshe manufa, juyawar sufuri — bincike na mai gudanarwa.
sub_screens.content_description: Mai bincike na ajiyar abun ciki na federation — an adana shi a cikin gida, federated, dawo da hash-adireshin.

peer_detail.confirm_block_body: Toshe zai ƙi duk zirga-zirga daga wannan abokin. Kuna iya cire toshe daga baya.
peer_detail.sas_instructions: Kwatanta waɗannan tare da abokin ta hanyar amintaccen channel (murya/video/a fuska). Idan ɓangarorin biyu sun dace, an tabbatar da abokin — juya amana zuwa TRUSTED.
peer_detail.title: Cikakken bayanin abokin
peer_detail.not_in_directory: Kumburinku ba shi da rikodin wannan maɓalli. An jera maɓallin da kumburinku ya ji kawai yana sanar da kansa, amma ba za a iya buɗe shi ba sai kumburinku ya karɓe shi.
peer_detail.sas_ceremony_title: Duba Wannan Maɓalli Tare da Su
peer_detail.sas_ceremony_instructions: Ku buɗe wannan shafi a ɓangarorin biyu, kowanne domin maɓallin ɗayan. Ku karanta kalmomi da lambobi da babbar murya wa juna, fuska da fuska ko kuma ta wayar da ku kanku kuka kira, sannan ku amsa kawai bayan kun ji nasu.
peer_detail.sas_state_verified: Eh — kun duba wannan maɓalli a ranar {date}
peer_detail.sas_scope_value: Ku kaɗai. Kumburinku yana ajiye shi; ba a gaya musu ba.
peer_detail.sas_covers: Lambar da ta dace tana nuna cewa maɓallin da kumburinku yake riƙe shi ne wanda kumburinsu yake riƙe. Ba ta faɗi ko su waye ba, kuma tana rufe maɓallin Ed25519 nasu ne, ba sashen post-quantum ba.
peer_detail.sas_fact_signs: Wa Yake Sa Hannu · Wa Yake Gani
peer_detail.sas_fact_signs_value: Kumburinku yana sa hannu a kansa. Ku kaɗai ne za ku iya ganinsa.
peer_detail.sas_confirm_match_changes: Kumburinku yana rubuta cewa kun kwatanta wannan lamba da su kuma ta dace.
peer_detail.sas_confirm_mismatch_changes: Kumburinku zai daina amincewa da wannan maɓalli (Ba a Amince da Shi), kuma duk wani daidaito da ku ka rubuta a baya za a janye shi.
peer_detail.sas_confirm_withdraw_changes: Daidaiton da ku ka rubuta ba zai ƙara kirgawa ba. Rikodin farkon zai ci gaba da kasancewa a tarihin kumburinku.
peer_detail.sas_mismatch_body: Kada ku raba wani abu na sirri da wannan maɓalli. Wataƙila wani yana tsakanin kumburanku, ko kuwa wannan ba maɓallinsu ba ne. Ku sake kwatantawa fuska da fuska, ko ta wayar da ku kanku kuka kira. Kumburinku ya daina amincewa da shi.
peer_detail.sas_not_in_directory: Kumburinku ya ji wannan maɓalli amma bai karɓe shi ba tukuna, don haka babu abin da za a kwatanta tukuna.
peer_detail.sas_not_on_this_node: Wannan kumburi ba zai iya kwatanta maɓallai tukuna ba. Yana buƙatar ciris-server 0.5.115 ko sabo.
peer_detail.sas_write_not_owner: Mai mallakar wannan kumburi kaɗai ne zai iya rubuta dubawa. Ku shiga a matsayin mai mallaka sannan ku sake gwadawa.
peer_detail.sas_write_failed: Kumburinku bai rubuta wannan ba. Babu abin da ya canza bayan matakin da ya gaza.
peer_detail.sas_write_partial: Kumburinku ya daina amincewa da wannan maɓalli; kawai rikodin dubawar ne ya gaza.

agent.title: Wakili (Kai)
agent.subtitle: Wakilin da kansa — kai a kowane sikeli.
agent.identities_description: Maɓallin asalin wakilin da kansa — adireshin federation da yake sa hannu a kowane gudunmawa. Sunan abokantaka daga config na gida; key_id daga CIRISEdge.
agent.trust_description: Amincewa da kai ita ce tushe. Dokar Zinariya Mai Sake Maimaitawa ba ta da banbanci — abin da wakili ke buƙata daga wasu, dole ne shi da kansa ya bi.
agent.policies_description: Manufofin da ke aiki da kai: yawan juyawar asali, sabunta tabbatarwa, abin da wakili yake a shirye ya sa hannu a wannan sikeli.

family.title: Iyali
family.subtitle: Sauran abubuwan da suka faru na CIRIS waɗanda suke raba asalin mai gudanarwa.
family.identities_description: Abubuwan da suka faru na ƴan'uwa (misalan runtime daban-daban na wakili guda) da occurrence_id nasu. Sunan abokantaka daga config na mai gudanarwa.
family.trust_description: Membobin iyali suna raba maɓallin sa hannu na mai gudanarwa ta tsohuwa — amincewa kai tsaye ita ce tushe. Hukunce-hukuncen kashewa / farkawa ana raba su gwargwadon haɗin gwiwa na abubuwan da suka faru.
family.policies_description: Manufofin abubuwan da suka faru: ɗaukar ayyukan da aka raba, iyakokin tsaro na abubuwan da suka faru, ƙididdigar yanke shawara don ayyukan sikelin iyali.

local_community.title: Al'umma ta gida
local_community.subtitle: Abokai amintattu na gida — tashar gida, gida, guild ɗaya.
local_community.identities_description: Abokan da mai gudanarwa ya amince da su a fili. Sunan abokantaka daga littafin lambobi; key_id daga teburin sanarwa.
local_community.trust_description: Amincewa kai tsaye da mai gudanarwa ya bayar. Ana iya soke ta a kowane lokaci. Gudunmawar sikelin gida tana zaman a cikin ƙungiyar gida kuma ba a buga ta a federation ba.
local_community.policies_description: Manufofin kowace al'umma: wanene zai iya gayyata, waɗanne ajin abun ciki ake karɓa, yadda ake warware rikice-rikice a wannan sikeli.

global_communities.title: Al'ummomi na duniya
global_communities.subtitle: Ƙungiyoyin haɗin kai na duniya da wakili ya shiga.
global_communities.identities_description: Al'ummomin da suka haɗu (haɗin kai, ƙungiyoyin sana'a, hanyoyin sadaka) waɗanda wakili ke shiga. Sunan abokantaka daga rejistar accord_holder; in ba haka ba key_id.
global_communities.trust_description: Amincewa tana wucewa ta hanyar membobinta na al'umma. Kowace al'umma tana da nata sharuɗɗan shiga da nata tsarin tabbatarwa.
global_communities.policies_description: Manufofin sikelin haɗi: waɗanne al'ummomi wakili zai karɓi jagora daga gare su, warware rikici tsakanin haɗi masu hamayya.

global_commons.title: Filin gama-gari na duniya
global_commons.subtitle: Federation a matsayin sikelin sararin samaniya — bil'adama, muhalli, tushe da kansa.
global_commons.identities_description: Duk asalai da ake gani a sikelin federation, gami da masu hukuncin tsayarwa na humanity_accord, manyan accord_holder, da kuma faɗin tafkin abokai.
global_commons.trust_description: A sikelin sararin samaniya, ana bayar da amincewa ta hanyar tsarin tabbatarwa na federation. Dokar Zinariya Mai Sake Maimaitawa tana ɗaurin kowane shugaba — gami da CIRIS L3C — a wannan sikeli.
global_commons.policies_description: Iyakokin tsarin mulki na duk federation: hukuncin tsayarwa na humanity_accord, kalmomin farko da aka ajiye ga accord_holder, girman ƙididdigar yanke shawara na locality:decision.

commons.title: Filin gama-gari
commons.description: Katunan gudunmawar federation: fayilolin accord, gwajin tsaro, shaidun ɗabi'a, sabunta rubric, jujjuyawa, wakilci. Kowane yana ɗauke da iyaka, tabbaci, bambancin shaidu, da jerin binciken da aka warware ta cikin sufurin ContentFetch na Edge.

participate.title: Shiga
participate.description: Rejistar buƙatun federation — wakilai sun yi rejista abin da suke buƙata (binciken rubric, shaidar tsaro, ikon wakilci) a matsayin tabbatarwar need:{domain}:{kind}; sauran wakilai suna gani, suna kima, suna amsawa.

environment_graph.title: Zane na muhalli
environment_graph.description: Zane na muhalli da aka samo daga lens — ƙididdigar daidaiton manifold a kowane ƙungiya, ma'aunin samun damar rabawa, gano ayyukan haɗin kai. Shimfiɗar zane sama da ƙididdigar federation wanda wakili ke yin tunani a kanta lokacin yanke shawara.

delegation.title: Wakilci
delegation.description: Zane na wakilci: sikelolin da aka wakilta zuwa kuma daga wannan wakili, tare da alamomin lokacin bayarwa, evidence_refs, da kowane jerin janyewa. Ɗaya daga cikin tushe 4 na tsari — ana mallaka tare da ƙididdigar federation.

trust_topology.title: Tsarin amincewa
trust_topology.description: Zane na amincewar federation — abokai a matsayin nodes, bayar da amincewa a matsayin gefuna (kai tsaye / wakilta / hamayya), launin gefe = samun damar sufuri, girman node = nauyin amincewa gabaɗaya.

constitutional.title: Tsarin mulki
constitutional.description: Filin asalin accord-holder — rashin daidaito na tsarin mulki guda ɗaya gwargwadon FSD-002 §4.1. Maɓallan identity_type=accord_holder kawai za su iya fitar da tabbatarwar accord:*; wannan allon yana nuna masu rikon yanzu, fitar da kalmomin farko na accord da suka yi, da binciken aiwatar da kalmomin farko da aka ajiye.

reader.advisory: Hukuncin da aka bayar shawara ce ga kowane mai karatu. Ƙin amincewa da shi sakamako ne cikakke na kansa, ba kuskure ba: masu karatu biyu masu manufofi daban-daban da suka kai ga yanayi daban-daban, duk biyun ingantattu, daga hukunci guda — wannan shi ne ƙirar tana aiki.

fold.diverges: Waɗannan sun bambanta — wanda hakan shi ne mai karatu yana yanke shawara. Ana rubuta ƙin amincewar kuma ana bayar da rahotonta; amma har yanzu ba ta sa wannan kumburi ya daina hanawa ba.

dialog.compelled_by_hint: Tilastawa kaɗai ce take ɗauke da wannan. Ka bar shi fanko idan ba za ka iya faɗa ba — «an tilasta mini, amma ba zan iya faɗin wa ya yi ba» amsa ce ta gaskiya, kuma mai gudanarwa da aka hana yin magana yana iya barin alamar duk da haka.
dialog.delegation_hint: ID ɗin delegates_to na mai shi da kansa. Aikin da kumburi ya yanke wa kansa na mai shi ne shi kaɗai: izinin bayarwa na wani ɓangare na uku ba zai isa ba.
